#### 546.pants. Time limits within which enforcement documents shall be submitted for enforcement

(1) An enforcement document may be submitted for compulsory enforcement within 10 years from the date of entry into force of the court's or judge's decision, unless other limitation periods are provided for by law.

(2) If periodic payments are recovered pursuant to a court judgment, the enforcement document shall remain in force for the entire period for which the payments are awarded, but the running of the period provided for in paragraph one of this Article shall start from the date of expiry of each payment.

(3) The time limits within which other enforcement documents referred to in Article 540 of this Law shall be submitted for enforcement shall be determined by the respective laws.

(With amendments made by the law of 31.10.2002, which enters into force 01.01.2003.)

#### 547.pants. Interruption of the limitation period for submission of an enforcement document

(1) The limitation period shall be interrupted by submitting the enforcement document for enforcement. The limitation period shall also be interrupted by partial voluntary execution of the decision.

(2) After the interruption, the running of the period shall start anew, not counting the time that has elapsed before. If complete recovery has not been made pursuant to the enforcement document and it has been returned to the creditor, the new period for submitting the document shall be counted from the day it was issued to the creditor.

(With amendments made by the law of 31.10.2002, which enters into force 01.01.2003.)

547.1 pants. Time limits for execution of requests for assistance regarding recovery from foreign institutions

If an enforcement document has been issued for the execution of a foreign tax claim, compulsory enforcement shall be carried out within the time limit specified in the request for assistance regarding recovery from a foreign institution, but in case of its change, within the time limit specified by the foreign institution in the notification submitted to the State Revenue Service.

(In the wording of the law of 15.03.2012, which enters into force 01.04.2012.)

68.nodaļa

Status of a bailiff

#### 548.pants. Bailiff

(1) Court and other decisions referred to in Article 539 of this Law shall be executed by a bailiff.

(2) Supervision of the activities of a bailiff shall be carried out in the manner provided for in this Law and in the Law on Bailiffs.

(In the wording of the law of 31.10.2002, which enters into force 01.01.2003.)

#### 549.pants. General rules of bailiff's activities

(1) A bailiff shall commence enforcement actions upon a written application of the creditor and, in cases provided for by law, on the initiative of the Council of Sworn Bailiffs of Latvia, the responsible institution, or on the initiative of the court, based on an enforcement document.

(2) A bailiff shall accept an enforcement document for enforcement if the debtor's place of residence (for legal persons — legal address), the location of the property or place of work is within the boundaries (district) established for the bailiff's office. A bailiff may also accept other enforcement documents to be enforced in the territory of operation of the regional court at which he or she exists.

(21) (Deleted by the law of 16.06.2022)

(22) A bailiff shall accept for enforcement an enforcement document concerning the return of a child to the country where he or she is habitually resident, or an enforcement document in a case arising from custody or contact rights, including a European Union enforcement document, if the location of the child is within the boundaries (district) established for the bailiff's office.

(23) If the debtor's place of residence (for legal persons — legal address), the location of the property or place of work is not in Latvia, a bailiff shall accept for enforcement the enforcement document referred to in paragraph 19 of Article 540 of this Law, regardless of the debtor's place of residence (for legal persons — legal address), the location of the property or place of work.

(3) Outside the boundaries of his or her district, as well as in relation to a debtor whose place of residence (for legal persons — legal address) is in another district, a bailiff shall execute a judgment in communication with the bailiff of the respective district in the manner determined by the Cabinet of Ministers.

(4) On Sundays and public holidays, the execution of a judgment shall be permitted only in urgent cases.

(5) Execution of a judgment between 24 o'clock and 6 o'clock shall not be permitted.

(6) The creditor and the debtor shall have the right to be present at enforcement actions, to invite no more than two witnesses and to receive information related to the execution of the judgment.

(7) A bailiff, on his or her own initiative or at the request of an interested person, by adopting an appropriate decision, may correct transcription errors in procedural documents drawn up in enforcement cases in his or her proceedings. Before correcting errors, he or she shall request a response from the persons who participated in drawing up the document. Obvious errors may be corrected without requesting a response. A bailiff's decision pursuant to which errors are corrected shall have no consequences in relation to persons whose rights or obligations arise from the procedural document.

(With amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002, 19.06.2003, 07.09.2006, 26.10.2006, 04.08.2011, 29.10.2015, 08.12.2016 and 16.06.2022, which enters into force 07.07.2022.)

#### 550.pants. Recusal or Challenge of Bailiff

(1) A bailiff is prohibited from conducting enforcement actions in cases in which one of the parties is the bailiff himself or herself, his or her spouse, including former spouse, relatives of the bailiff or his or her spouse in direct line in all degrees, in collateral line — up to the fourth degree and in affinity relations — up to the third degree, persons under guardianship or curatorship of the bailiff or his or her spouse or adoptive parents or adoptees of the bailiff or his or her spouse, as well as when other circumstances exist under the influence of which the bailiff cannot reasonably maintain objectivity and neutrality.

(2) A challenge to a bailiff may be filed by the creditor or debtor, by submitting a written application to the bailiff, if circumstances exist that give rise to justified doubts regarding the bailiff's objectivity. The bailiff shall decide on the application immediately. A decision by which the application is left without satisfaction may be appealed to the district (city) court at the bailiff's place of office. Filing of a complaint does not suspend enforcement actions.

(3) An ancillary complaint may be filed regarding a court decision to refuse a challenge to a bailiff.

(4) If a bailiff has recused himself or herself or has been challenged, he or she shall transfer the enforcement document for further enforcement to another bailiff in the procedure established by the Council of Sworn Bailiffs of Latvia.

(31.10.2002. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 05.02.2009. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.03.2009.)

#### 551.pants. Binding Nature of Bailiff's Demands or Orders

(1) A bailiff's demands and orders in enforcing court judgments and other decisions are binding on natural and legal persons throughout the territory of the state. State institutions shall provide information necessary for ensuring enforcement of judgments and other decisions to a sworn bailiff free of charge.

(2) If a bailiff's demands or orders are not complied with, the bailiff shall draw up a report thereof and submit it to the court for decision on the matter of liability. The court may impose a fine on the guilty persons: on a natural person up to 360 euro, but on an official — up to 750 euro. An ancillary complaint may be filed regarding the court decision.

(3) A person (employer) who, pursuant to a court decision, was required to withhold maintenance for a child or parent and who has not notified the bailiff and the maintenance recipient within the period prescribed by law of the release of the maintenance payer from work, as well as of his or her new place of work or residence, if it is known to such person, may be imposed a fine by the court up to 150 euro. An ancillary complaint may be filed regarding the court decision.

(4) If resistance is shown in enforcing a judgment, the bailiff shall, in the presence of invited persons, but if it is not possible to invite persons — unilaterally, draw up a report thereof and, in order to remove obstacles, apply to the police for assistance. The report shall be submitted to the court for decision on the matter of liability of those persons who resisted enforcement of the judgment.

(5) If the creditor or debtor refuses to sign a report drawn up by the bailiff, a note thereof shall be made in the report drawn up, indicating the reasons for the refusal. Refusal to sign a report drawn up by the bailiff does not affect the validity of the report.

(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 31.10.2002., 19.06.2003., 09.06.2011., 23.05.2013., 12.09.2013. un 09.06.2016. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 13.07.2016.)

#### 552.pants. Debtor's Obligations and Consequences of Non-Fulfillment Thereof

(1) Upon summons, the debtor appears before the bailiff and provides explanations regarding his or her financial situation and place of work, simultaneously informing of sums to which enforcement may not be applied (Section 596).

(2) The debtor shall notify the bailiff of a change in place of work or declared place of residence, additional address or place of residence indicated in the declaration during enforcement of the decision, as well as of additional sources of income.

(3) If the debtor fails to appear before the bailiff upon summons, refuses to provide explanations or does not provide information prescribed by law, the bailiff may apply to the court for decision on the matter of liability of such person. The court may adopt a decision on compulsory bringing of the debtor, as well as impose a fine on him or her: on a natural person up to 80 euro, but on an official — up to 360 euro. An ancillary complaint may be filed regarding the court decision.

(4) If it is established that the debtor has provided false information, the bailiff shall send an application to the prosecutor. (Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 31.10.2002., 19.06.2003., 08.09.2011., 29.11.2012., 12.09.2013., 29.10.2015. un 09.06.2016. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 13.07.2016.)

69.nodaļa

General Provisions of Enforcement Proceedings

552.1 pants. Opening of Enforcement Case

(1) A bailiff shall open a separate enforcement case for each enforcement document received.

(2) If an enforcement document is not executed in the procedure prescribed by law or the documents required pursuant to international agreements binding on the Republic of Latvia or European Union legal norms are not attached thereto, the state fee or other enforcement costs have not been paid, the bailiff shall set a time limit for remedying deficiencies, which may not be shorter than 10 days.

(3) If the deficiencies are remedied within the set time limit, an enforcement case shall be opened and the enforcement document shall be deemed submitted on the day when it was first submitted to the bailiff.

(4) If the creditor does not remedy the deficiencies within the set time limit, the enforcement document shall be deemed not submitted and shall be returned to the creditor.

(5) Return of an enforcement document to the creditor is not an obstacle to its repeated submission to the bailiff, observing the procedure for submission of enforcement documents prescribed by law.

(6) If the bailiff establishes that insolvency proceedings have been declared for the debtor, or a sworn notary has accepted an application for discharge of a natural person from debt obligations, which includes debt obligations for which the received enforcement document was issued, the enforcement case shall not be opened and the enforcement document shall be returned to the submitter, except in cases where the enforcement document has been issued in claims the enforcement of which is not related to application of enforcement to the debtor's property or funds. An enforcement case shall also not be opened for voluntary sale of immovable property at auction or transfer of movable property.

(7) If the bailiff establishes that sanctions apply to the creditor pursuant to the Law on International and National Sanctions of the Republic of Latvia (hereinafter — sanctions), including such sanctions imposed by a member state of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization on the creditor which, pursuant to regulations of the Bank of Latvia, significantly affect the interests of a financial market participant or the financial market, the enforcement case shall not be opened and the enforcement document shall be returned to the submitter, except in cases where enforcement of a specific decision would not result in violation, circumvention or evasion of the requirements imposed by the sanctions for such person.

(31.10.2002. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 30.09.2010., 18.04.2013., 30.10.2014., 11.11.2021., 15.06.2021. un 16.03.2023. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 29.03.2023.)

#### 553.pants. Clarification of Enforceable Court Decision

If an enforceable court decision is not clear, the bailiff is entitled to request that the court which adopted the decision clarify it. Clarification of the decision shall take place in the procedure set out in Section 202 or 437 of this law.

(31.10.2002. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2003.)

#### 554.pants. Postponement of Judgment Enforcement, Division into Terms, Amendment of Method or Procedure of Its Enforcement

(1) If circumstances exist that make enforcement of a court judgment difficult or render it impossible, the bailiff is entitled to submit to the court which rendered the judgment in the case a proposal for postponement of judgment enforcement, division into terms, amendment of the method or procedure of its enforcement.

(2) The court shall examine the bailiff's application for postponement of judgment enforcement, division into terms, amendment of the method or procedure of its enforcement in the procedure set out in Section 206 or 438 of this law.

(31.10.2002. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2003.)

#### 555.pants. Notification of the Obligation to Execute the Decision

(1) Upon commencing execution, the bailiff shall notify the debtor, by sending or issuing a notice, of the obligation to execute the decision within 10 days. If the decision is executable immediately, the term for execution shall be set at no less than three days. In cases concerning the execution of confiscation of property and the execution of a decision on securing a claim or the application of interim protection that does not impose on the defendant a prohibition or obligation to perform certain actions, a notice of the obligation to execute the decision shall not be sent.

(11) Upon commencing the execution of the writ of execution referred to in point 17 of Section 540 of this Law, except in cases where the writ of execution provides for the execution of a measure for securing a claim or interim protection, or the execution of the writ of execution referred to in point

20 of Section 540 of this Law, the bailiff shall send or issue the writ of execution to the debtor together with the notice. If the documents submitted to the bailiff do not show that the enforceable court decision, public deed or settlement has been issued to the debtor, the enforceable court decision, public deed or settlement shall also be attached to the writ of execution.

(2) If the debtor is a natural person, the bailiff shall send the notice to the debtor to the official electronic address, but if this is not possible, by registered mail to his or her last known place of residence or issue it to the debtor personally against signature. If the bailiff does not find the debtor at his or her place of residence, he or she shall issue the notice to one of the adult family members living together with the debtor.

(3) If the debtor — a natural person — does not have an official electronic address and his or her place of residence is unknown, the notice of the obligation to execute the decision shall be published in the official gazette "Latvijas Vēstnesis".

(4) If the debtor is a legal person, the bailiff shall send the notice to the official electronic address, but if this is not possible, by registered mail to the debtor's legal address or issue it personally against signature to a representative of the debtor's executive body.

(5) If the debtor or a representative of the debtor's executive body refuses to accept or sign the notice, the bailiff or the deliverer of the request shall draw up an act to that effect. Refusal to accept or sign the notice shall not be an obstacle to the forced execution of the decision.

(6) If the notice (in the case referred to in Paragraph 1.1 of this Section — also the specified documents) has been delivered in accordance with the procedure laid down in this Section, the debtor shall be deemed to have been notified of the decision and the term for its execution.

(7) The bailiff may at any stage of the execution proceedings:

- 1) request that the debtor declare his or her financial situation and changes therein during the last year, warning the debtor of criminal liability;
- 2) seize the debtor's property, including seizing monetary funds and deposits in credit institutions or with other payment service providers, monetary funds owed by other persons, or property held by other persons;
- 3) submit a request for certification to the district (city) court for the entry of a note of recovery in the land register or send an order to another public register for the entry of a prohibition on alienation or other actions.

(31.10.2002. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 19.06.2003., 05.02.2009., 08.09.2011., 04.08.2011., 29.11.2012., 30.10.2014., 29.10.2015., 23.11.2016., 22.06.2017., 25.10.2018., 11.11.2021. un 16.06.2022. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 07.07.2022. 1.1 daļas pirmā teikuma jaunā redakcija stājas spēkā 01.08.2022. Sk. pārejas noteikumu

177. punktu)

555.1 pants. Sending of Documents

Documents prepared by the bailiff and other documents related to the execution of the decision provided for in this Law shall be sent electronically to the addressee's official electronic address or to the electronic mail address specified by the addressee, if he or she has notified the bailiff that he or she agrees to communicate with the bailiff using electronic mail. If it is not possible to send the documents electronically, they shall be sent by ordinary mail, but the documents to be sent specified in the fourth part of Section 581, the first part of Section 583.1, the third part of Section 584, the first and third parts of Section 600, the second part of Section 604, the fifth part of Section 606, the first and third parts of Section 618.2, the first part of Section 618.6 and the fourth part of Section 644.33 of this Law — by registered mail. If it is not possible to send electronically the notice specified in point 1 of the first part of Section 620.14 and point 1 of the first part of Section 620.28 of this Law, it shall be issued to the claimant against signature or sent by registered mail, or transmitted through the Ministry of Justice.

(11.11.2021. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.12.2021.)

#### 556.pants. Forced Execution of Court Judgment

(Izslēgts ar 08.09.2011. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 30.09.2011.)

#### 557.pants. Means of Forced Execution

The means of forced execution are:

- 1) levying execution on the debtor's movable property, including property held by other persons, and incorporeal things, by selling them;
- 2) levying execution on money owed to the debtor by other persons (wages, payments equivalent thereto, other income of the debtor, deposits in credit institutions or with other payment service providers);
- 3) levying execution on the debtor's immovable property, by selling it;
- 31) levying execution on the debtor's building rights, by selling them;
- 4) transfer of the property awarded by the court to the claimant and performance of the actions imposed by the court judgment;
- 5) eviction of persons and property specified in the judgment from the premises;
- 6) introduction into possession;
- 61) return of the child to the country in which he or she has his or her place of residence;
- 7) other means specified in the judgment.

(31.10.2002. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 04.08.2011., 23.11.2016. un 01.03.2018. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.07.2018.)

#### 558.pants. Inspection of the Debtor's Premises

(1) The bailiff shall be entitled, if necessary for the levying of execution, to inspect the debtor's premises and his or her storage facility. If the debtor does not participate in the inspection of the premises and storage facility, it shall be carried out in the presence of invited persons.

(2) If the debtor refuses to admit the bailiff to the premises which he or she occupies, or to the location of the property, or refuses to open the storage facility, the bailiff shall invite a police representative, in whose presence the premises or storage facility shall be opened and inspected.

(3) If the manager of the immovable property belonging to the debtor evades or refuses to admit the bailiff to the immovable property during the forced execution of the decision and the manager has been notified in writing of the time of the inspection of the immovable property at least five days in advance, the bailiff may conduct the inspection of the immovable property in the presence of a police representative without the manager's participation.

(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 31.10.2002. un 19.06.2003. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 24.07.2003.)

#### 559.pants. Postponement of enforcement action

(1) The bailiff postpones enforcement action on the basis of the creditor's application or a court or judge's decision on postponement of enforcement action or suspension of sale of property, adopted in accordance with Section 138, Paragraph 1, Clause 7 or Section 138.1, Paragraph 1, Clause 4 of this Law, or a court decision on postponement of execution of judgment or division into instalments, adopted in accordance with Sections 206, 438, 644.1, 620.16 of this Law.

(2) The bailiff postpones enforcement action on the basis of a court decision to replace the execution of a foreign court or competent authority's decision with the measures provided for in Section 138 of this Law to secure the execution of such decision (Section 644.2).

(21) The bailiff postpones enforcement on property that has been seized in criminal proceedings and for the sale of which the process director has not given permission, until the seizure is lifted in criminal proceedings or permission from the process director is received.

(3) The bailiff notifies the creditor and debtor of the postponement of enforcement action if it cannot be performed due to technical or other reasons beyond the bailiff's control.

(4) If within 30 days from the date of sending the documents referred to in Section 555, Paragraph 1.1 of this Law, the bailiff receives the debtor's request to send a translation of the enforceable court decision, public deed or settlement, the bailiff, having established the circumstances referred to in European Union legal norms that provide for the debtor's right to request a translation of the documents to be issued, postpones the enforcement action until the translation is sent to the debtor.

(In the wording of the Law of 31.10.2002 with amendments made by the Laws of 19.06.2003, 07.09.2006, 05.02.2009, 04.08.2011, 30.10.2014, 29.10.2015 and 16.06.2022, which enters into force on 07.07.2022. The amendment to the first paragraph regarding the deletion of the numbers and words "620.22 or 620.29" enters into force on 01.08.2022. See transitional provision Clause 177)

#### 560.pants. Bailiff's duty to suspend enforcement proceedings

(1) The bailiff suspends enforcement proceedings if:

- 1) the natural person who is the debtor or creditor has died or the legal person who is the debtor or creditor has ceased to exist and the legal relationship established by the court allows for succession of rights;
- 2) the debtor's legal capacity has been restricted by court judgment to the extent in which enforcement proceedings are taking place;
- 3) the Supreme Court has adopted a decision to suspend execution of the judgment at a procedural hearing;
- 4) execution of an institution's or official's decision must be suspended in accordance with law or a court decision;
- 5) the court or judge has adopted a decision to suspend forced execution of an obligation (Sections 406 and 406.10);
- 6) the court has adopted a decision to suspend execution of a foreign court or competent authority's decision (Section 644.2);
- 7) legal protection proceedings have been initiated for the debtor or a decision has been adopted on the implementation of legal protection proceedings in the case of out-of-court legal protection proceedings;
- 71) the court has declared legal protection proceedings and approved a legal protection measures plan, if the consequences provided for in Section 37, Paragraph 1, Clauses 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 of the Insolvency Law have previously been revoked or have lost effect on the basis of law;
- 8) insolvency proceedings for a natural person have been declared for the debtor;
- 9) in a case concerning the return of a child to the country of his or her residence, or in a case arising from custody rights, it is not possible for the orphan's court to ascertain the child's daily schedule or it is not possible to encounter the child;
- 10) a document on non-execution of a decision in a case arising from contact rights has been sent to the orphan's court;
- 11) a sworn notary's notice has been received regarding the acceptance of an application for the discharge of a natural person from debt obligations, which includes debt obligations for the recovery of which an enforcement case has been initiated;
- 12) sanctions are applicable to the creditor, the restrictions established by which are incompatible with the execution of the relevant decision.
  - (2) If a decision on privatization of an enterprise or commercial company has been adopted in the manner prescribed by law, enforcement proceedings shall be suspended at the request of the privatization authority, except enforcement proceedings for compensation of damages in connection with an accident at work or occupational disease.
  - (21) If the debtor whose debt is being recovered on the basis of a uniform instrument permitting enforcement in the requested Member State has contested or appealed the claim in the applicant Member State or has submitted a complaint regarding enforcement actions carried out in the applicant Member State and a complaint examination procedure has been initiated in a Member State institution, enforcement proceedings shall be suspended at the request of the State Revenue Service with regard to the contested or appealed part of the claim and in accordance with the request of the Member State institution which has requested mutual assistance in claim recovery.
  - (22) If the debtor whose debt is being recovered on the basis of a decision of a competent authority of a European Union Member State or European Economic Area country regarding the imposition of an administrative fine related to violations in the field of posting of workers has contested or appealed the decision in the applicant Member State, enforcement proceedings shall be suspended at the request of the State Labour Inspectorate with regard to the contested or appealed part of the decision and in accordance with the notification of the applicant Member State.
  - (3) In the cases referred to in Clauses 7 and 7.1 of Paragraph 1 of this Section, the bailiff shall deduct the costs of execution of the judgment from the amount of money recovered and satisfy the creditor's claim in the manner prescribed by this Law. If a legal protection measures plan has been approved, the bailiff shall deduct the costs of execution of the judgment from the amount of money recovered and satisfy the creditor's claim in the amount and manner specified in the legal protection measures plan.
  - (4) In the case referred to in Clause 8 of Paragraph 1 of this Section, the bailiff shall complete the initiated sale of property if it has already been announced or the property has been handed over to a trading company for sale, except in the case where the sale plan for the natural person's property provides for postponing the sale of the dwelling in accordance with Section 148 of the Insolvency Law. From the money received from the sale, the bailiff shall deduct the costs of execution of the judgment, and transfer the remaining money to the administrator for satisfaction of creditors' claims in accordance with the procedure established in the Insolvency Law, observing the rights of the secured creditor.
  - (5) The provisions of Clause 8 of Paragraph 1 of this Section do not apply to enforcement cases concerning claims the execution of which is not related to enforcement against the debtor's property or monetary funds. The bailiff shall also suspend enforcement proceedings if an enforcement document has been issued in claims the execution of which is related to voluntary sale of immovable property at auction or transfer of movable property.
  - (6) Application of sanctions to the debtor is not a basis for suspending enforcement proceedings, but until the sanctions are lifted, the means of forced execution applied to the debtor's property shall not be revoked and monetary funds shall not be paid to the debtor if such are due to him in the case.

(With amendments made by the Laws of 31.10.2002, 07.09.2006, 05.02.2009, 11.06.2009, 30.09.2010, 04.08.2011, 15.03.2012, 29.11.2012, 18.04.2013, 30.10.2014, 29.10.2015, 04.02.2016, 11.11.2021, 15.06.2021 and 16.03.2023, which enters into force on 29.03.2023. See transitional provision Clause 179)

#### 561.pants. Bailiff's right to suspend enforcement proceedings

The bailiff may suspend enforcement proceedings if:

- 1) the debtor is at a medical institution and this hinders the performance of enforcement actions;
- 2) a complaint has been submitted regarding the bailiff's actions;
- 3) (deleted by the Law of 31.10.2002);
- 4) (deleted by the Law of 14.12.2006).

(With amendments made by the Laws of 31.10.2002, 19.06.2003 and 14.12.2006, which enters into force on 01.03.2007.)

#### 562.pants. Terms for Suspension of Enforcement Proceedings

(1) Enforcement proceedings are suspended:

- 1) in the cases provided for in point 1 of the first part of Article 560 of this law — until the determination of the successor in title of the debtor or creditor;
- 2) in the cases provided for in point 2 of the first part of Article 560 of this law — until the appointment of a guardian;
- 3) in the cases provided for in points 3, 5 and 6 of the first part of Article 560 of this law — until the time specified in the court decision, or until the revocation of this decision;
- 4) (deleted by the law of 19.06.2003.);
- 5) in the cases provided for in point 4 of the first part of Article 560 of this law — until the time when the suspension ceases in accordance with the law, or the time specified in the court ruling, or until the revocation of this ruling;
- 6) in the case provided for in the second part of Article 560 of this law — until the determination of the debtor's successor in title and the transfer of the enterprise to him or her, or the making of amendments to the founding documents of the company in the Enterprise Register;
- 7) in the case provided for in point 1 of Article 561 of this law — until the moment when the circumstances mentioned in this point have ceased;
- 8) in the cases provided for in point 2 of Article 561 of this law — until the moment when the court judgment or decision in connection with a complaint enters into legal force;
- 9) (deleted by the law of 19.06.2003.);
- 10) in the cases provided for in point 7 of the first part of Article 560 of this law — until the moment when one of the following circumstances has occurred:
  - a) the legal protection proceedings have been terminated with respect to the debtor,
  - b) the implementation of legal protection proceedings has been announced with respect to the debtor and the judgment on the implementation of the legal protection proceedings does not indicate that the debtor's property serving as security (pledged) is included in the legal protection proceedings action plan and restrictions apply to it according to which secured creditors may not exercise their rights to this property,
  - c) in the case referred to in point 2 of the second part of Article 341.5 of this law, the court has granted permission to sell the pledged property of the debtor,
  - d) the consequences specified in points 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 of the first part of Article 37 of the Insolvency Law have been revoked by a court decision or have lost force by law in accordance with the information provided by the supervisor of the legal protection proceedings and a legal protection proceedings action plan has not been submitted to the court;
- 101) in the cases provided for in point 7.1 of the first part of Article 560 of this law — until the moment when one of the following circumstances has occurred:
  - a) the legal protection proceedings have been terminated with respect to the debtor,
  - b) the implementation of legal protection proceedings has been announced with respect to the debtor and the judgment on the implementation of the legal protection proceedings does not indicate that the debtor's property serving as security (pledged) is included in the legal protection proceedings action plan and restrictions apply to it according to which secured creditors may not exercise their rights to this property;
- 11) in the case provided for in point 8 of the first part of Article 560 of this law — until the court ruling on the termination of bankruptcy proceedings, or until the end of the period specified in the first part of Article 165.1 of the Insolvency Law, if the debtor's discharge from obligations has not been revoked, or until the moment when the debtor's discharge from obligations is revoked. Enforcement proceedings are resumed for the amount of the remaining debt;
- 12) in the case provided for in point 9 of the first part of Article 560 of this law — until the determination of the child's whereabouts;
- 13) in the case provided for in part 2.1 of Article 560 of this law — until the moment when a notification from the State Revenue Service has been received that, according to the information provided by the authority of the Member State that requested mutual assistance in the recovery of claims, the decision on the contestation or enforcement of the claim adopted in the complaint examination procedure has become enforceable;
- 14) in the case referred to in point 10 of the first part of Article 560 of this law — until the moment when the orphan's court decision has entered into force or the orphan's court assessment has been received;
- 15) in the case provided for in part 2.2 of Article 560 of this law — until the moment when a notification from the State Labour Inspectorate has been received that, according to the information provided by the requesting Member State, the decision on the contestation or appeal of the decision adopted in the complaint examination procedure has become enforceable;
- 16) in the cases provided for in point 11 of the first part of Article 560 of this law — until the day when:
  - a) an entry has been made in the insolvency register on the result of the examination of the application for the natural person's discharge from debt obligations and the natural person has not been discharged from debt obligations,
  - b) the time limit for submitting an application for the revocation of the natural person's discharge from debt obligations has expired, if an entry on the natural person's discharge from debt obligations has been made in the insolvency register,
  - c) a court judgment revoking the natural person's discharge from debt obligations has entered into force;
- 17) in the case provided for in point 12 of the first part of Article 560 of this law — until the revocation of sanctions applicable to the creditor.
  - (2) During the time when enforcement proceedings are suspended, the bailiff does not carry out enforcement actions. The bailiff revokes the operation of the issued order for the duration of the suspension of enforcement proceedings, while preserving the registered prohibition and recovery marks.
  - (21) In the cases referred to in points 7 and 8 of the first part of Article 560 of this law, the bailiff notifies the custodian of the property of the obligation to hand over to the supervisor of the legal protection proceedings or the administrator the property the sale of which has not been commenced. Registered prohibition and recovery marks shall be deleted if:
- 1) a legal protection proceedings action plan has been submitted to the bailiff which provides for actions regarding the property belonging to the debtor to which the bailiff has applied enforcement measures;
- 2) an application from the administrator has been submitted regarding the necessity of the property within the framework of bankruptcy proceedings.
  - (3) Enforcement proceedings are resumed upon the creditor's application or at the bailiff's initiative.
  - (4) In the cases referred to in sub-points "b" and "c" of point 10 of the first part of this Article and in sub-point "b" of point 10.1 of the first part of this Article, in the resumed enforcement proceedings the bailiff carries out only the sale of pledged property.

(With amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002., 19.06.2003., 07.09.2006., 14.12.2006., 11.06.2009., 30.09.2010., 04.08.2011., 15.03.2012., 29.11.2012., 29.10.2015., 04.02.2016., 01.10.2020., 11.11.2021., 15.06.2021. and 16.03.2023., which enters into force on 29.03.2023. See transitional provision point 179)

#### 563.pants. Termination of Enforcement Proceedings

(1) Enforcement proceedings shall be terminated at the request of an interested person if:

- 1) the creditor has waived the claim and the court has adopted a relevant decision thereon;
- 2) a settlement between the creditor and the debtor approved by the court has been submitted;
- 3) the claim or obligation cannot pass to a successor in title upon the death of the natural person or termination of the legal person who was the creditor or debtor;
- 4) the limitation period provided for by law for this type of claim has expired;
- 5) the court decision or the decision of the relevant institution or official on the basis of which the enforcement document was issued has been revoked;
- 6) the time limit for lodging an appeal, cassation appeal or subsidiary complaint against the court decision on the basis of which the enforcement document was issued has been restored;
- 7) enforcement of a decision of a foreign court or competent authority has been refused (Article 644.3);
- 8) the foreign court or competent authority revokes the issued European Union enforcement document;
- 9) a court decision has been adopted to terminate legal protection proceedings in connection with the performance of the legal protection proceedings plan;
- 91) enforcement of a decision on the return of a child to the country of his or her habitual residence has been refused;
- 92) (deleted by law of 16.06.2022);
- 10) a court decision has been adopted to terminate proceedings for the discharge of obligations of a natural person, releasing the natural person from its debt obligations, and the time limit specified in the first paragraph of Article 165.1 of the Insolvency Law has expired and the release of the debtor from obligations has not been revoked, or a court decision has been adopted to terminate bankruptcy proceedings if no creditors' claims have been submitted in accordance with the procedure laid down in the Insolvency Law, simultaneously terminating the insolvency proceedings of the natural person;
- 11) a foreign authority withdraws a request for assistance regarding the recovery of tax, duty, costs related to recovery or other mandatory payment;
- 12) a notification has been received from the State Labour Inspectorate that, in accordance with the information provided by the requesting Member State, the decision of the competent authority of a Member State of the European Union or of a country of the European Economic Area to impose an administrative fine related to infringements in the field of posting of workers has been revoked;
- 13) (deleted by law of 16.06.2022);
- 14) an entry has been made in the insolvency register concerning the result of the examination of an application for the discharge of a natural person from debt obligations, the natural person has been discharged from debt obligations and the prescribed time limit for submitting an application for the revocation of the discharge of the natural person from debt obligations has expired.
  - (2) Enforcement proceedings for the recovery of an adjudged monetary sum from legal persons, partnerships, individual merchants, persons registered abroad conducting permanent economic activity in Latvia, and agricultural producers shall be terminated at the request of an administrator if insolvency has been declared for the debtor in the manner prescribed by law. In this case, the bailiff shall complete the sale of property that has been initiated, if it has already been announced or the property has been handed over to a trading company for sale, unless the administrator has requested that the announced auction be cancelled in order to ensure the sale of the property as part of a unity of things. From the money received from the sale, the bailiff shall withhold the costs of enforcement of the judgment, but the remaining money shall be transferred to the administrator for the satisfaction of creditors' claims in accordance with the procedure laid down in the Insolvency Law, observing the rights of the secured creditor. The bailiff shall notify the keeper of the property of the obligation to transfer to the administrator the property the sale of which has not been initiated.
  - (3) In the cases provided for in points 3 and 4 of paragraph 1 of this Article, the bailiff may also terminate enforcement proceedings on his or her own initiative.
  - (31) In the cases provided for in point 10 of paragraph 1 of this Article, enforcement proceedings shall not be terminated for:
- 1) recovery of maintenance;
- 2) claims arising from unlawful acts;
- 3) claims for penalties provided for in the Criminal Law and in normative acts that define administrative offences;
- 4) claims in respect of compensation for harm caused by a criminal offence or administrative offence;
- 5) claims arising from infringements referred to in Chapters IV and V of the Commercial Activity Support Control Law, in cases where the creditor has, at the request of the bailiff, provided information that the enforcement proceedings are renewable.
  - (32) If, in the case referred to in point 3 of paragraph 1 of this Article, the legal person who is the debtor in the enforcement case has been liquidated, the bailiff shall continue enforcement proceedings in the part concerning the enforcement against the debtor's property. The amounts recovered that remain after satisfaction of the creditor's claim shall be credited to the state budget.
  - (4) If enforcement proceedings are terminated, after payment of the costs of enforcement of the judgment, all coercive enforcement measures taken by the bailiff shall be revoked.
  - (5) Terminated enforcement proceedings may not be initiated anew.
  - (6) If a foreign court or competent authority corrects a European Enforcement Order issued on the basis of Regulation (EC) No 805/2004 of the European Parliament and of the Council, enforcement of the decision in the part revoked shall be terminated and enforcement shall be continued in accordance with the corrected European Enforcement Order.
  - (7) If a court, foreign court or competent authority amends a European Account Preservation Order on the basis of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, enforcement of the decision in the part revoked shall be terminated and enforcement shall be continued in accordance with the amended European Account Preservation Order.
  - (8) If a foreign court amends a certificate issued in accordance with Article 47 of Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111, enforcement of the decision in the part revoked shall be terminated and enforcement shall be continued in accordance with the certificate issued by the foreign court in accordance with Article 49 of Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111.

(As amended by the laws of 31.10.2002, 07.09.2006, 05.02.2009, 30.09.2010, 04.08.2011, 15.03.2012 and 16.03.2023, which entered into force on 29.03.2023. See point 179 of the transitional provisions)

#### 564.pants. Procedure for Postponement of Enforcement Actions, Suspension, Resumption or Termination of Enforcement Proceedings

(1) The decision on the postponement of enforcement actions, suspension, resumption or termination of enforcement proceedings shall be taken by the bailiff in whose proceedings the enforcement document is located.

(2) The bailiff shall adopt a decision prior to the action to be postponed or enforced, but no later than within three days from the date of receipt of the application.

(3) The bailiff shall notify the creditor, the debtor and the relevant third party who has submitted a request of the decision within three days of the adoption of the decision.

(In wording of the law of 19.06.2003, which entered into force on 24.07.2003.)

#### 565.pants. Return of enforcement document to creditor

(1) An enforcement document according to which enforcement has not been carried out or has been carried out incompletely shall be returned to the creditor:

- 1) upon application of the creditor;
- 2) if the debtor has no property or income against which enforcement can be directed;
- 3) if the creditor has refused to receive items seized from the debtor that are specified in the court judgment;
- 4) if the debtor does not live or work at the address indicated by the creditor or their property is not located there;
- 5) if the creditor, who has not been exempted from payment of enforcement costs of the judgment, has not paid them;
- 6) if it is not possible to enforce the judgment by applying the means of enforcement indicated by the creditor and the creditor has not notified of the application of another means of enforcement within 10 days after the issuance of the invitation;
- 7) if in a case concerning the return of a child to the country of their habitual residence, or in a case arising from custody or access rights, the bailiff establishes that the child's location is outside the territorial jurisdiction of the regional court to which this bailiff is attached, or abroad;
- 8) if in a case concerning the return of a child to the country of their habitual residence, the creditor has twice failed to indicate, following an invitation from the bailiff, the Ministry of Justice or the orphan's court, the time and place when and where the child should be brought to them, or the time and place (as close as possible to the child's location) when and where they will meet with the child to restore the bond between the creditor and the child;
- 9) if in an enforcement case arising from custody and access rights, the creditor repeatedly fails to appear at the time appointed by the bailiff to receive or meet with the child;
- 10) if the debtor's custody rights have been terminated in connection with the failure to comply with the decision in a case arising from custody or access rights;
- 11) if the bailiff establishes in accordance with Section 620.27 of this law that enforcement of the decision is not possible.
- 12) if the debtor has died and within one year from the suspension of enforcement proceedings no succession case has been initiated regarding their estate.
  - (2) In the cases referred to in points 2, 3 and 4 of paragraph one of this Section, the bailiff shall draw up a corresponding act.
  - (21) If in an enforcement case concerning the collection of periodic payments the debt and the enforcement costs of the judgment are fully covered, the enforcement document shall be issued to the creditor.
  - (22) If in an enforcement case arising from access rights the bailiff has established that the court decision is being complied with and the enforcement costs of the judgment have been covered, the enforcement document shall be issued to the creditor.
  - (3) The enforcement document shall be issued to the creditor if the enforcement costs of the judgment have been covered, except where the enforcement costs of the judgment are paid by the creditor in accordance with the provisions of this law. When issuing the enforcement document to the creditor, the bailiff shall revoke all adopted means of enforcement.
  - (4) The return of the enforcement document to the creditor shall not preclude the resubmission of this document for enforcement within the time limit prescribed by law.
  - (5) An enforcement document according to which enforcement is to be made in state revenues shall be issued by the bailiff to the State Revenue Service.
  - (6) (Deleted by the law of 05.02.2009.)
  - (7) The writ of execution shall not be issued to the creditor, but a note shall be appended to it regarding the reason for completion of the enforcement case and the amount collected. The notes made by the bailiff shall be an integral part of the writ of execution.

(With amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002., 19.06.2003., 17.06.2004., 05.02.2009., 04.08.2011., 29.10.2015., 25.03.2021. and 11.11.2021., which enter into force on 01.12.2021.)

#### 566.pants. Enforcement costs of the judgment

(1) The enforcement costs of the judgment include the state fee and the costs related to the enforcement of the court judgment (Section 39): the bailiff's remuneration in the amount of the tariff and the costs necessary for performing enforcement actions. These are:

- 1) costs associated with the delivery and issuance of summonses and other documents;
- 2) costs in connection with receiving information necessary in the enforcement case;
- 3) costs in connection with the services of banks and other institutions;
- 4) costs in connection with the storage, transportation or destruction of the debtor's property;
- 5) travel costs to reach the place of enforcement of the judgment;
- 6) payment to an expert;
- 7) costs for organizing an auction at an electronic auction site;
- 71) costs related to the examination of the case, arising in connection with the bailiff's application for the registration of immovable property in the name of the acquirer submitted to the court;
- 8) other costs necessary for performing enforcement actions.
  - (2) (Deleted from 01.01.2012. by the law of 31.10.2002.)
  - (3) When determining costs associated with securing a claim or interim protection, the provisions on enforcement costs of the judgment shall apply insofar as these actions have been performed by the bailiff.

(In the wording of the law of 20.06.2001. with amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002., 20.12.2010., 04.08.2011., 25.03.2021. and

11.11.2021., which enter into force on 01.12.2021.)

#### 567.pants. Procedure for Payment of Judgment Enforcement Costs in Enforcement Proceedings

(1) The creditor, when submitting an enforcement document for enforcement, shall specify the means of compulsory enforcement, observing the provisions of Sections 570 and 572 of this Law, pay the state fee and cover other judgment enforcement costs to the extent necessary to commence enforcement in the manner specified by the creditor. During the enforcement of the judgment, the creditor shall pay additionally required judgment enforcement costs upon the instruction of the bailiff. In cases specified by law, during the enforcement of the judgment, judgment enforcement costs for individual procedural actions shall be paid by the debtor.

(11) A creditor — a natural person — in a claim for recovery of compensation for harm in criminal proceedings is exempt from the obligation to specify the means of compulsory enforcement. The applicable means of compulsory enforcement, observing the provisions of Section 570 of this Law, shall be determined by the bailiff.

(2) The following creditors are exempt from payment of judgment enforcement costs to the bailiff:

- 1) in claims for recovery of wages and other claims of employees and persons in service arising from or related to legal employment or service relationships;
- 2) in claims arising from personal injuries resulting in mutilation or other health damage or in the death of a person;
- 21) in cases where recovery is made in favour of an injured person — a natural person — in connection with a satisfied application for compensation for harm in criminal proceedings;
- 3) in claims for recovery of maintenance for a child or parent;
- 4) in cases where recovery is made into state revenues;
- 5) in cases where a person has been exempted from payment of court costs by a court decision — in full or in part in accordance with the court decision;
- 6) in cases where recovery is made in accordance with a uniform instrument permitting enforcement in the requested Member State, except in cases where the State Revenue Service has agreed with the authority of a Member State that has requested mutual assistance in the recovery of claims on a special procedure for reimbursement of enforcement costs;
- 7) who are whistleblowers and their relatives or related persons in claims brought with such status, including in applications for securing a claim or interim protection.
  - (3) In cases where the creditor is exempt from payment of judgment enforcement costs, the sworn bailiff shall be paid compensation from state budget funds to cover costs related to the performance of enforcement actions.
  - (4) The amount of costs necessary for the performance of enforcement actions and the procedure for their payment, as well as the procedure for determining the amount of compensation and its payment in cases where the creditor is exempt from payment of judgment enforcement costs, shall be determined by the Cabinet of Ministers.
  - (41) If, when recovering compensation for harm in the case referred to in point 2.1 of the second paragraph of this Section, the sum recovered from the debtor is insufficient to cover the judgment enforcement costs in full, the remuneration in the amount of the fee and the costs necessary for the performance of enforcement actions in the uncovered part shall be covered to the bailiff from state budget funds in the procedure established by the Cabinet of Ministers.
  - (5) (Deleted as of 01.03.2016. by the Law of 04.02.2016. See paragraph 113 of Transitional Provisions)
  - (6) The bailiff may submit to the State Revenue Service a request for judgment enforcement costs necessary for the performance of enforcement and request that it agree with the authority of the respective Member State that has requested mutual assistance in the recovery of claims on a special procedure for reimbursement of costs if at least one of the following cases is established:
- 1) judgment enforcement costs in a very large amount are necessary for the recovery of a tax claim;
- 2) the recovery is directed at property of a member of an organised group that has been confiscated by a judgment in criminal proceedings (Article 20 of Council Directive 2010/24/EC).

(31.10.2002. version of the Law with amendments made by the Laws of 19.06.2003., 26.10.2006., 05.02.2009., 09.06.2011.,

#### 568.pants. Recovery of Judgment Enforcement Costs

(1) Enforcement of the judgment shall take place at the debtor's expense. After the enforcement document has been submitted for enforcement, voluntary enforcement of the judgment or enforcement of the judgment directly to the creditor shall not exempt the debtor from reimbursement of judgment enforcement costs.

(11) If an enforcement document is issued to the creditor in accordance with points 1, 3, 6, 8, 9 or

12 of the first paragraph of Section 565 of this Law, or after the initiation of the enforcement file the bailiff establishes that the debtor has fulfilled its obligations before the submission of the enforcement document, the judgment enforcement costs shall be covered by the creditor. This provision also applies to the cases referred to in points 1, 2, 2.1, 3 and 5 of the second paragraph of Section 567 of this Law.

(12) If enforcement proceedings are to be terminated, except in the cases specified in points 4 and 11 of the first paragraph of Section 563 of this Law, as well as in cases where an enforcement document is issued to the creditor on the basis of point 2 or 7 of the first paragraph of Section 565 of this Law, the judgment enforcement costs, insofar as they have not been recovered from the debtor, shall be covered by the creditor if it is not exempt from their payment to the bailiff in accordance with this Law.

(13) If enforcement proceedings have been terminated in accordance with point 14 of the first paragraph of Section 563 of this Law, the judgment enforcement costs, insofar as they have not been recovered from the debtor, shall be covered by the creditor if it is not exempt from payment of judgment enforcement costs to the bailiff in accordance with this Law.

(2) The bailiff shall prepare a calculation of judgment enforcement costs and send it to the debtor and the creditor. The calculation may be appealed in the procedure specified in Section 632 of this Law.

(3) The calculation shall indicate the extent to which judgment enforcement costs are reimbursable to the bailiff (official remuneration), to the creditor (the state fee paid by it and other judgment enforcement costs) or payable into state revenues.

(4) If it is not possible to recover judgment enforcement costs from the debtor or in the cases referred to in paragraphs 1.1, 1.2 and six of this Section they have not been covered by the creditor, the bailiff shall issue an invoice on the basis of the prepared calculation and submit it for compulsory enforcement.

(5) An invoice shall be submitted for compulsory enforcement after the expiry of the time limit for appealing the bailiff's calculation of judgment enforcement costs, but if it has been appealed — after the court decision enters into legal force.

(6) Costs related to a court decision on securing a claim, the imposition of an interim protection measure or the enforcement of a European Account Preservation Order shall be covered by the claimant.

(61) If enforcement proceedings have been terminated in accordance with point 4 of the first paragraph of Section 563 of this Law and judgment enforcement costs have not been recovered from the debtor, the enforcement proceedings shall be terminated in the part concerning the enforcement of the decision, but shall continue in the part concerning the recovery of judgment enforcement costs.

(7) If enforcement proceedings have been terminated in accordance with point 11 of the first paragraph of Section 563 of this Law and the reason for the withdrawal of the request for assistance is the cancellation of the claim to be recovered or the document issued for its enforcement, the bailiff shall submit to the State Revenue Service a calculation of enforcement costs and request that it agree with the authority of the Member State that requested mutual assistance in the recovery of claims on the reimbursement of enforcement costs. (31.10.2002. version of the Law with amendments made by the Laws of 05.02.2009., 15.03.2012., 08.12.2016., 25.03.2021. and 15.06.2021., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

#### 569.pants. Search for debtor or child

(1) If the whereabouts of the debtor are unknown, the judge, upon request of the interested party, adopts a decision to search for the debtor with the assistance of the police in the following cases:

- 1) on recovery of maintenance for a child or parent;
- 2) on claims for personal injury resulting in mutilation or other health damage or death of a person;
- 3) on recovery to state revenues.
  - (11) If the whereabouts of the child or the debtor and child are unknown, the judge, upon request of the bailiff, adopts a decision to search for the aforementioned persons with the assistance of the police in the following cases:
- 1) in cases concerning the return of a child to the country of his or her habitual residence;
- 2) when a European Union enforcement order for the return of a child to the country of his or her habitual residence has been received;
- 3) in cases arising from custody rights.
  - (2) Upon application of the police institution, the court adopts a decision on recovery of search expenses from the debtor.

Application of Enforcement Measures

Chapter 70

General Provisions of Recovery

#### 570.pants. Recovery against property of natural person

(1) Recovery is enforced against the property of a natural person, including this person's share in joint ownership and in marital community property, as well as in cases provided by law — against marital property community.

(2) Recovery against the debtor's property is not enforced if the debtor works or receives a pension or scholarship and the amount of recovery does not exceed the part of monthly income against which recovery may be enforced by law.

(3) Recovery against the debtor's immovable property is permitted if, by applying other enforcement measures, it is not possible to satisfy the creditor's claim within a reasonable time. This procedure does not apply to the recovery of debts secured by mortgaging the respective immovable property.

(Amendments made by the law of 22.05.2014., which enters into force 05.06.2014.)

#### 571.pants. Property against which recovery may not be enforced

When executing judgments, recovery may not be enforced against the property mentioned in Annex 1 of this law, except for the recovery of debts secured by mortgaging the respective items.

(Amendments made by the law of 31.10.2002., which enters into force 01.01.2003.)

#### 572.pants. Recovery from legal person

(1) Recovery according to enforcement documents is first enforced by the bailiff against the monetary funds of the legal person located in credit institutions or with other payment service providers.

(2) If, by enforcing recovery against the monetary funds of the legal person in credit institutions or with other payment service providers, the creditor's claim is not satisfied, recovery is enforced against the property of the legal person. (In the version of 31.10.2002. law with amendments made by the law of 23.11.2016., which enters into force 01.01.2017. Amendments to the article enter into force 01.07.2017. See transitional provision point 120)

572.1 pants. Recovery in favor of Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration

(1) If the creditor has expressed a respective request, as well as a request to apply all the enforcement measures specified in points 1, 2 and 3 of Article 557 of this law, and if the debtor in the notice of the obligation to execute the decision within the specified time has not deposited into the bailiff's deposit account the amount specified in the notice, the bailiff notifies the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration that the decision on recovery of maintenance or the notarial act containing an agreement on periodic maintenance payments and enforceable in the manner of execution of court judgments is not being executed.

(2) If the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration, based on the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Law, has substituted the creditor in a maintenance recovery case in the part concerning the recovery from the debtor of maintenance paid from the Maintenance Guarantee Fund, it has all the rights and obligations of the creditor provided by this law.

(3) The enforcement order of the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration for recovery of unduly paid maintenance amounts from the applicant is not returned to the creditor. If the bailiff, at the request of the creditor, has provided the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration with the information specified in the first paragraph of this article, the enforcement document is issued to the creditor only after a confirmation of the absence of a claim has been received from the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration.

(In the version of 05.02.2009. law with amendments made by the laws of 12.06.2009., 19.12.2013. and 08.12.2016., which enters into force 04.01.2017. New version of the first and third paragraphs on recovery in favor of the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration enters into force 01.02.2017. and applies to enforcement cases instituted from 01.02.2017. See transitional provision point 123)

572.2 pants. Rights and obligations of State Revenue Service in enforcement cases concerning execution of confiscation of property

In enforcement cases concerning execution of confiscation of property, the State Revenue Service has all the rights and obligations of the creditor provided by this law.

(In the version of 22.06.2017. law, which enters into force 01.08.2017.)

Chapter 71

Recovery against movable property

#### 573.pants. Attachment of debtor's movable property

(1) Attachment of debtor's movable property is expressed in the description, photographic recording and safeguarding of this property, insofar as a different attachment procedure is not established in this chapter for individual items.

(2) (Deleted by the law of 05.02.2009.)

(3) The bailiff does not attach movable items if it could be impossible to sell them and the costs of execution of the judgment could exceed the amount of money obtained from the sale.

(In the version of 31.10.2002. law with amendments made by the laws of 07.09.2006., 05.02.2009. and 01.03.2018., which enters into force 01.07.2018.)
