The bailiff, upon receiving information that the child's location is not known, shall request the judge in accordance with Section 569 of this Law to adopt a decision on the search for the child or the child and the debtor with the assistance of the police and shall suspend enforcement proceedings.

(3) The bailiff, having received from the orphan's court or the police information about the child's location, which is in the territorial jurisdiction of the regional court to which this bailiff does not belong, shall make a note thereof in the enforcement document, indicating information about the child's location, and shall immediately issue the enforcement document to the creditor, explaining to him or her the right to submit the enforcement document for enforcement in accordance with the provisions of Section 549 of this Law.

(4) (Deleted by the Law of 29.10.2015.)

(With amendments made by the Law of 29.10.2015., which enters into force on 03.12.2015.)

620.14 pants. Handing over the child to the creditor or to the representative of the orphan's court

(1) Upon receiving the information referred to in the first paragraph of Section 620.13 of this Law, the bailiff shall determine the times and places when and where the child will be handed over to the creditor or to the representative of the orphan's court, if the creditor does not participate in the enforcement, and shall notify thereof:

- 1) the creditor, informing him or her of the creditor's right to be present at enforcement actions;
- 2) the orphan's court and the police at the place where the child is located, issuing an order for their representatives to participate in the enforcement. The orphan's court, at its discretion, shall invite a psychologist to participate in the enforcement.
  - (2) The bailiff shall not inform the debtor of the times and places when and where the child will be handed over to the creditor or to the representative of the orphan's court, if the creditor does not participate in the enforcement.
  - (3) The handing over of the child to the creditor or to the representative of the orphan's court shall be carried out as quickly as possible.
  - (4) The bailiff, representatives of the orphan's court and the police, as well as a psychologist, if the orphan's court has invited one, shall participate in the handing over of the child. At the time and place specified in the order of the bailiff, the representative of the orphan's court, in cooperation with the psychologist, if one has been invited, shall conduct conversations with the debtor or other persons with whom the child is located, in order to persuade them to hand over the child to the creditor or to the representative of the orphan's court, if the creditor does not participate in the enforcement, as well as to prepare the child for return to the country of his or her habitual residence. The police representatives shall ensure public order and compliance with the order of the bailiff.
  - (5) If the bailiff is not allowed to enter premises in respect of which there is information that the child is located there, they shall be opened by force in the presence of a police representative. If no person older than seven years is found in the premises, the bailiff, after the forced opening of the premises, without describing the property in the premises, shall ensure the safe closing and sealing of these premises. The bailiff shall leave a notice at the relevant immovable property or premises with an invitation to come to the bailiff's office to receive the keys to the premises. The bailiff shall make a note in the record of actions related to the forced opening of the premises.
  - (6) If the child is handed over to the creditor, the bailiff shall make a note in the record of the handing over of the child, indicating that the decision has been enforced.
  - (7) If the child is handed over to the representative of the orphan's court for further actions to return the child to the country of his or her habitual residence, the bailiff shall make a note in the record of the handing over of the child. A copy of the record shall be issued to the representative of the orphan's court. After receiving the notice from the orphan's court that the child has been returned to the country of his or her habitual residence, the bailiff shall draw up a record that the decision has been enforced.

(With amendments made by the Laws of 29.10.2015. and 11.11.2021., which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

620.15 pants. Actions of the bailiff if it is not possible to hand over the child to the creditor or to the representative of the orphan's court If it is not possible for the orphan's court to obtain the information referred to in Section 620.13 of this Law or the return of the child to the country of his or her habitual residence is not possible because the child has not been found at the times and places determined by the bailiff, the bailiff shall draw up a record thereof and send this record to the prosecutor's office so that it may decide on the initiation of criminal proceedings against the debtor in connection with his or her malicious evasion of the enforcement of the decision, and shall suspend enforcement proceedings. 620.16 pants. Refusal or postponement of enforcement of the decision

(1) The debtor may submit to the district (city) court that has adopted the decision on the return of the child to the country of his or her habitual residence a proposal for the postponement of the enforcement of the decision or for the refusal of enforcement of the decision if there has been a substantial change in circumstances.

(2) A substantial change in circumstances within the meaning of this Section shall include:

- 1) that the return of the child to the country of his or her habitual residence is not possible due to the child's health or psychological condition, as evidenced by a hospital or psychiatric certificate;
- 2) the child's objections to his or her return to the country of his or her habitual residence, as evidenced by the opinion of a psychologist appointed by the orphan's court;
- 3) that the creditor does not show interest in re-establishing contact with the child.
  - (3) The proposal referred to in the first paragraph of this Section may be submitted if more than one year has passed since the decision on the return of the child to the country of his or her habitual residence (Section 644.20), except in the case referred to in Point 1 of the second paragraph of this Section.
  - (4) The application shall be considered in a court hearing, having previously notified the parties and the orphan's court thereof. The failure of these persons to appear shall not be an obstacle to the consideration of the application.
  - (5) In the decision on the postponement of the enforcement of the decision, the court shall specify the obligations of the debtor and the creditor during the period when the enforcement of the decision is postponed and, if necessary, also the procedure for re-establishing contact between the child and the creditor.
  - (6) The decision shall be enforceable immediately. An appeal may be submitted against the court decision. The submission of an appeal shall not suspend the enforcement of the decision.

(With amendments made by the Laws of 29.10.2015. and 16.06.2022., which enters into force on 07.07.2022.)

### 74. nodaļa Execution of Decisions in Matters Arising from Guardianship Rights

(Chapter in the wording of the law of 29.10.2015., which enters into force on 03.12.2015.)

620.17 pants. Notice of Obligation to Execute Decision

The notice of the obligation to hand over the child to the creditor within 15 days shall be sent or issued by the bailiff to the debtor in accordance with the procedure laid down in Article 555 of this Law. In the notice, the bailiff shall warn the debtor of the consequences provided for in this Chapter that will arise if the decision is not executed.

620.18 pants. Civil Procedural Consequences Arising if the Debtor Does Not Execute the Decision

(1) If the debtor has not executed the decision within the time limit specified in the bailiff's notice, the bailiff shall send information thereof to the district (city) court that has adopted the decision in a matter arising from guardianship rights, or in whose territory of operation the foreign decision is to be executed.

(2) The judge, upon receipt of the information referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, shall impose a fine of up to 1500 euro on the debtor.

(3) The issue of imposing a fine shall be examined in written proceedings.

(4) The judge's decision on imposing a fine shall be sent to the debtor.

(5) An appeal may be lodged against the court's decision on imposing a fine.

(6) The fine shall be recovered from the debtor to state revenues.

(7) Payment of the fine does not release the debtor from the obligation to execute the decision.

(With amendments made by the laws of 09.06.2016. and 11.11.2021., which enter into force on 01.12.2021.)

620.19 pants. Clarification of the Child's Daily Routine

(1) If it is necessary for the execution of the decision, the bailiff shall order the orphan's court at the child's location to clarify the child's daily routine within 15 days from the date of receipt of the order and inform the bailiff thereof.

(2) The orphan's court shall immediately inform the bailiff of the information relating to the child and his or her location obtained when executing the order specified in paragraph 1 of this Article. If it is not possible to obtain the said information, the orphan's court shall inform the bailiff thereof.

(3) The bailiff, having received information that the child's location is not known, in accordance with Article 569 of this Law, shall request the judge to adopt a decision on the search for the child or the child and the debtor with the assistance of the police and shall suspend enforcement proceedings.

(4) The bailiff, having received from the orphan's court or the police information about the child's location which is in the territory of operation of a regional court where this bailiff does not exist, shall make a note thereof in the enforcement document, indicating information about the child's location, and shall immediately issue the enforcement document to the creditor, explaining to him or her the right to submit the enforcement document for execution in accordance with the provisions of Article 549 of this Law.

620.20 pants. Handing Over of the Child to the Creditor

(1) Having received the information referred to in paragraph 1 of Article 620.19 of this Law, the bailiff shall determine the place and time where and when the child will be handed over to the creditor and shall notify the creditor, the orphan's court and the police at the child's location thereof, ordering their representatives to participate in the forced execution. The orphan's court, at its discretion, shall involve a psychologist in the forced execution of the decision.

(2) The bailiff shall not inform the debtor of the place and time where and when the child will be handed over to the creditor.

(3) The child shall be handed over to the creditor as soon as possible.

(4) If the creditor does not appear at the time and place determined by the bailiff, the bailiff shall postpone the handing over of the child. If the creditor also repeatedly fails to appear at the specified time and has not notified the reason for non-appearance or has not appeared for a reason that the bailiff does not recognize as justified, the enforcement document shall be returned to the creditor without execution.

(5) The handing over of the child shall be attended by the bailiff, representatives of the orphan's court and the police, as well as a psychologist, if the orphan's court has involved one. At the place and time specified in the bailiff's order, the representative of the orphan's court, in cooperation with the psychologist, if one has been involved, shall conduct conversations with the debtor or other persons with whom the child is located, in order to persuade them to hand over the child to the creditor, as well as to prepare the child for handing over to the creditor. Police representatives shall ensure public order and compliance with the bailiff's orders.

(6) If the bailiff is not allowed into the premises about which there is information that the child is located therein, they shall be opened by force in the presence of a police representative. If no person older than seven years is found in the premises, the bailiff, after forcibly opening the premises, without describing the property in the premises, shall ensure the secure closing and sealing of these premises. The bailiff shall leave a notice at the relevant immovable property or premises with an invitation to come to the bailiff's office to receive the keys to the premises. The bailiff shall make a note in the report on the actions related to the forced opening of the premises.

(7) The bailiff shall make a note in the report on the handing over of the child to the creditor, indicating that the decision has been executed.

620.21 pants. Actions of the Bailiff if it is Not Possible to Hand Over the Child to the Creditor

If it is not possible for the orphan's court to obtain the information referred to in Article 620.19 of this Law or the handing over of the child to the creditor does not take place because the child is not found at the place and time determined by the bailiff, the bailiff shall prepare a report thereon and send it to the prosecutor's office for it to decide on the initiation of criminal proceedings against the debtor in connection with his or her malicious evasion of the execution of the decision, as well as send the report to the orphan's court for evaluation of the debtor's actions and suspend enforcement proceedings.

620.22 pants. Refusal or Postponement of Execution of a Foreign Decision

(Deleted from 01.08.2022. by the law of 16.06.2022., which enters into force on 07.07.2022. See paragraph 177 of the transitional provisions)

### 74. Chapter Enforcement of Decisions in Matters Arising from Contact Rights

(Chapter in the version of the law of 29.10.2015., which enters into force on 03.12.2015.)

620.23 Article. Notification of the Obligation to Enforce the Decision

(1) If the decision (including a foreign court decision and a court decision on the review of the time and place of exercise of contact rights adopted in the procedure established in Article 244.13 of this law, if the court has not ordered the forced opening of premises) has established the procedure, time and place for the creditor's exercise of contact rights, the bailiff shall send to the debtor a notification of the obligation to enforce the decision in the procedure, time and place specified therein, in the procedure established in Article 555 of this law. If the time and place are not specified in the decision, the bailiff shall determine the place and time of enforcement within a reasonable period, but not later than two weeks, unless the decision provides otherwise. In the notification, the bailiff shall warn the debtor of the consequences provided for in this chapter in the event of non-enforcement of the decision.

(2) If the decision provides that contact rights are to be exercised in a specified place or in the presence of a contact person or a representative of the orphan's court or a person authorized by the orphan's court, or in a specified place and in the presence of a contact person or a representative of the orphan's court or a person authorized by the orphan's court, the bailiff shall also notify the contact person, the orphan's court and the user of the premises of the specified place about the time and place of enforcement of the decision, giving an order to the contact person or the representative of the orphan's court or the person authorized by the orphan's court to participate in the enforcement and an order to the user of the premises of the specified place to ensure access to the specified place.

(With amendments made by the law of 16.06.2022., which enters into force on 07.07.2022.)

620.24 Article. Act on the Enforcement or Non-enforcement of the Decision

(1) If, at the time and place determined by the bailiff, the debtor ensures the creditor's contact with the child in accordance with the procedure for exercising contact rights established in the decision, the bailiff shall draw up an act that the decision is being enforced. If, at the time and place indicated by the bailiff, the child is not found and the debtor has not notified the reason why the child is not found, or has notified a reason that the bailiff does not consider justified, or the debtor refuses to enforce the decision for a reason that the bailiff does not consider justified, the bailiff shall draw up an act on non-enforcement of the decision.

(2) If, at the time and place indicated by the bailiff, the child is not found, but the debtor has notified the reason why the child is not found and the bailiff considers this reason justified, or the debtor refuses to enforce the decision for a reason that the bailiff considers justified, the bailiff shall draw up an act on non-enforcement of the decision for justified reasons and shall determine a new time and place for the enforcement of the decision.

620.25 Article. Civil Procedural Consequences Arising if the Debtor Fails to Enforce the Decision

(1) The bailiff shall send the act on non-enforcement of the decision to the district (city) court that adopted the decision in the matter arising from contact rights, or in whose territory of operation the foreign court decision is to be enforced.

(2) Upon receipt of the act referred to in the first paragraph of this Article, the judge shall impose a fine of up to 1500 euros on the debtor.

(3) The issue of imposing a fine shall be examined in written proceedings.

(4) The judge's decision on imposing a fine shall be sent to the debtor.

(5) An appeal may be filed against the court's decision on imposing a fine.

(6) The fine shall be recovered from the debtor to state revenues.

(7) Payment of the fine shall not release the debtor from the obligation to enforce the decision.

(With amendments made by the laws of 09.06.2016. and 11.11.2021. and 16.06.2022., which enters into force on 07.07.2022.)

620.26 Article. Actions of the Bailiff if it is Not Possible to Hand Over the Child to the Creditor

If, after the issue of imposing a fine has been examined (Article 620.25), the debtor fails to comply with the bailiff's repeated order to enforce the decision given in accordance with the procedure established in Article 620.23 of this law, and an act on non-enforcement of the decision has been repeatedly drawn up in accordance with the first paragraph of Article 620.24 of this law, the bailiff shall send the said act to the prosecutor's office for it to decide on the initiation of criminal proceedings against the debtor in connection with his or her malicious evasion of the enforcement of the decision, and shall also send the act to the orphan's court for evaluation of the debtor's actions and shall suspend enforcement proceedings.

620.27 Article. Issuance of the Enforcement Document to the Creditor

If, after the resumption of enforcement proceedings, the debtor continues to fail to enforce the decision or there are other circumstances that make enforcement difficult or impossible, the bailiff shall return the enforcement document to the creditor, informing the creditor of his or her rights under Article 244.13 of this law to request the court to review the procedure for exercising contact rights.

620.28 Article. Procedure for Enforcing a Decision on the Review of the Time and Place of Exercise of Contact Rights if the Court has Ordered the Forced Opening of Premises

(1) The bailiff, upon commencing enforcement of a court decision on the review of the time and place of exercise of contact rights adopted in the procedure established in Article 244.13 of this law, taking into account the address and time period indicated in the decision during which the premises may be opened by force, shall determine the time and place when and where the child will be handed over to the creditor for the exercise of contact, and shall notify:

- 1) the creditor, informing him or her of the creditor's obligation to be present during enforcement actions;
- 2) the contact person in whose presence, in accordance with the decision, contact rights are to be exercised, giving an order to this person to participate in the enforcement;
- 3) the orphan's court at the child's place of location, giving an order to its representative to participate in forced enforcement. The orphan's court, at its discretion, shall invite a psychologist to participate in the forced enforcement of the decision;
- 4) the police at the child's place of location, giving an order to its representative to participate in forced enforcement.
  - (2) The bailiff shall not inform the debtor of the place and time where and when the child will be handed over to the creditor for the exercise of contact.
  - (3) At the place and time specified in the bailiff's order, the representative of the orphan's court, in cooperation with a psychologist, if one has been invited, shall hold discussions with the debtor or other persons with whom the child is located in order to persuade them to hand over the child to the creditor for the exercise of contact. Police representatives shall ensure public order and compliance with the bailiff's orders.
  - (4) If the bailiff is not allowed into the premises indicated in the court decision, they shall be opened by force. If no person older than seven years is found in the premises, the bailiff, after the forced opening of the premises, without describing the property in the premises, shall ensure the secure closing and sealing of these premises. The bailiff shall leave a notice at the relevant immovable property or premises with an invitation to come to the bailiff's office to receive the keys to the premises. The bailiff shall make a note in the act of actions related to the forced opening of premises.
  - (5) If the child is handed over to the creditor, the bailiff shall draw up an act on the enforcement of the decision.
  - (6) If contact rights are to be exercised in a specified place or in the presence of a contact person in another place that is not the place of enforcement, the child shall be handed over to the representative of the orphan's court or the contact person so that, together with the creditor, they may take the child to the specified place for the exercise of contact. The bailiff shall draw up an act on the enforcement of the decision, indicating the person to whom the child was handed over.
  - (7) If, when performing the actions specified in this Article, it was not possible to hand over the child to the creditor, the bailiff shall close the enforcement case without enforcement and shall inform the creditor of his or her rights under Article 244.13 of this law to request the court to review the procedure for exercising contact rights.

(With amendments made by the law of 11.11.2021., which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

620.29 Article. Postponement or Refusal of Enforcement of a Foreign Decision

(Deleted from 01.08.2022. by the law of 16.06.2022., which enters into force on 07.07.2022. See transitional provision 177)

75.Chapter

Distribution of Collected Amounts Among Creditors

#### 621.pants. Distribution of Recovered Amounts to Claimants

(1) From the amount that the bailiff has recovered from the debtor, first the enforcement costs are covered, from the remaining amount the claims of claimants that are substantiated by enforcement documents in this bailiff's proceedings are satisfied. The amount that remains after satisfying all claims is returned to the debtor.

(2) Amounts that have been recovered from the debtor and are to be transferred to claimants shall be credited to the bailiff's deposit account, and then issued or transferred in the prescribed manner.

(3) Amounts to be credited to state revenues shall be paid by the bailiff into the State Treasury budget account.

(4) Amounts recovered in favor of a person residing abroad shall be transferred to the claimant in the prescribed manner.

(5) Persons who have enforcement documents in other cases may join the enforcement by submitting the enforcement document to the bailiff who is organizing the auction no later than seven days before the closing date of the auction indicated in the auction announcement or until the date when the property has been handed over for sale in a trading company according to commission rules.

(With amendments made by laws of 31.10.2002., 05.02.2009. and 28.05.2015., which enter into force on 02.07.2015.)

#### 622.pants. Order of Satisfaction of Claimants' Claims

(1) If the amount recovered from the debtor is insufficient to satisfy all claims under enforcement documents, this amount shall be distributed among the claimants in the order specified in this law, unless a separate law establishes priorities for certain claimants.

(2) Claims of each subsequent category shall be satisfied after complete satisfaction of claims of the previous category.

(3) If the recovered amount is insufficient to fully satisfy all claims of one category, these claims shall be satisfied proportionally to the amount due to each claimant.

(4) If in the bailiff's proceedings there are several enforcement cases that have been initiated for the claims mentioned in the first part of Article 623 of this law, and among them there is an enforcement case in which the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration has taken the place of the claimant in part for the recovery from the debtor of maintenance that has been paid from the Maintenance Guarantee Fund, and the recovered amount is insufficient to fully satisfy all claims, the recovered amount shall be distributed proportionally to the debt amount calculated in the enforcement cases or the total amount of debts if there are several claimants in the case.

(With amendments made by law of 08.12.2016., which enters into force on 04.01.2017.)

#### 623.pants. First Category Enforcement

(1) First to be satisfied:

- 1) claims for recovery of maintenance for a child or parent or claims of the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration for recovery of maintenance debt;
- 2) claims for recovery of wages;
- 3) claims for personal injuries resulting in mutilation or other health damage or death of a person;
- 4) claims for a satisfied compensation claim of a natural person in a criminal case.

(2) If maintenance is paid in accordance with a decision of the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration and the recovered maintenance amount:

- 1) does not ensure the amount of maintenance paid from the Maintenance Guarantee Fund, the recovered maintenance shall be credited to the Maintenance Guarantee Fund;
- 2) ensures the amount of maintenance paid from the Maintenance Guarantee Fund, but does not ensure the minimum amount of maintenance as determined by the Cabinet of Ministers based on the fifth part of Article 179 of the Civil Law, the recovered maintenance shall be paid to the applicant;
- 3) ensures the minimum amount of maintenance as determined by the Cabinet of Ministers based on the fifth part of Article 179 of the Civil Law, then the maintenance in the amount determined by the said Cabinet of Ministers shall be paid to the applicant, and the remaining amount shall be credited to the Maintenance Guarantee Fund until complete repayment of the debt.

(3) If in the bailiff's proceedings there is an enforcement case for recovery of maintenance for a child and a case in which the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration has taken the place of the same claimant in part for the recovery from the debtor of maintenance that has been paid from the Maintenance Guarantee Fund, but the payment of maintenance to the claimant from the Maintenance Guarantee Fund has been terminated because the debtor's obligation to provide maintenance to his or her child each month has ended, the recovered maintenance shall be credited to the Maintenance Guarantee Fund until complete repayment of the debt.

(With amendments made by laws of 17.06.2004., 09.06.2011., 08.12.2016., 22.06.2017., 21.01.2021. and 25.03.2021., which enters into force on 20.04.2021.)

#### 624.pants. Second Category Enforcement

In the second category, claims for taxes and non-tax payments to the budget shall be satisfied.

#### 625.pants. Third Category Enforcement

In the third category shall be satisfied:

- 1) claims of natural persons for compensation for damages caused to their property by a criminal offense, if compensation for damages is determined based on a court judgment in a civil case or administrative violation;
- 2) claims for payments for management activities in a multi-apartment residential building (management expenses), for payments for services necessary for house maintenance (utility services) and payments to the apartment owners' association reserve fund (reserves) payable for this real estate.

(In the version of law of 21.01.2021., which enters into force on 01.03.2021. See transitional provision 162.)

#### 626.pants. Fourth Category Enforcement

In the fourth category, all other claims shall be satisfied.

#### 627.pants. Distribution of Money Received from the Sale of Movable Property Encumbered by Pledge

From the money received for the sold movable property encumbered by a pledge, first the enforcement costs shall be covered, then claims shall be satisfied in the following order:

- 1) the claim secured by the pledge;
- 2) other claims in the order specified in this law.

#### 628.pants. Distribution of money received from sale of mortgaged real estate

(1) From the money received for the sold mortgaged real estate, first the costs of judgment enforcement related to the sale of the real estate shall be covered, then claims shall be satisfied in the following order:

- 1) claims of those employees for payment of wages who are related to the maintenance of the real estate, and social insurance payments related to their wages;
- 2) claims for tax payments payable for this real estate;
- 21) claims for payments for management activities in a multi-apartment residential building (management costs), for payments for services necessary for the maintenance of the building (utilities) and payments to the apartment owners' association reserve fund (reserves) payable for this real estate;
- 3) real burdens recorded in the land register for which the payment term has arrived;
- 4) claims secured by the mortgage of this real estate according to their priority;
- 5) other claims in the order specified in this law, including the claims specified in point 2.1 of this paragraph in their unsatisfied part.
  - (11) When satisfying claims in the order specified in point 2.1 of the first paragraph of this article, they shall be covered in an amount that in total does not exceed 5 percent of the money received for this real estate.
  - (2) When satisfying mortgage claims according to their priority, their ancillary claims shall also be satisfied simultaneously — interest for the last three years until the day of the conclusion of the auction, awarded court costs and costs related to the conduct of the case, not exceeding the amount of the mortgage recorded in the land register. In the remaining part not secured by the mortgage (hypothec) of the real estate, the claim shall be satisfied in the order specified in Article 622 of this law.
  - (21) If the mortgage creditor has not joined the enforcement (fifth paragraph of Article 621), the money in the amount of the mortgage specified in the land register or in the amount specified in the mortgage creditor's notice, if such has been received (fourth paragraph of Article 600), taking into account the priority of the respective mortgage claim, shall be deposited into the deposit account of the bailiff who organized the auction, and kept until the receipt of enforcement documents.
  - (3) If real estate has been sold at auction in respect of which a lien right note is recorded in the land register, the money in the amount of the claim according to the priority of the claim shall be deposited into the bailiff's deposit account and kept until the secured claim is heard in court.

(With amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002., 05.02.2009., 28.05.2015. and 21.01.2021., which enter into force

01.03.2021. See transitional provision point 161.)

#### 629.pants. Distribution of money received from sale of a ship

From the money received for the sold ship, enforcement costs are covered and other claims are satisfied, taking into account the second paragraph of Article 56 of the Maritime Code.

(In the wording of the law of 19.06.2003., which enters into force 24.07.2003.)

#### 630.pants. Order of enforcement in cases where the debtor's property has been confiscated by judgment in a criminal case

(1) When executing a criminal case judgment on confiscation of property, the bailiff pays the monetary funds obtained from executing the judgment on confiscation of property into the State Treasury budget account after all claims submitted against the debtor that arose before the convicted person's property was arrested or pledged by the preliminary investigation authorities or the court have been satisfied.

(2) Claims for maintenance and claims for personal harm resulting in mutilation or other health damage or death of a person shall be satisfied even if they arose after the arrest of the convicted person's property or its pledging.

(With amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002. and 22.06.2017., which enters into force 01.08.2017.)

#### 631.pants. Calculation prepared by the bailiff

(1) If the court has recognized the creditor's right to receive interest on the awarded amount until the execution of the judgment (day of conclusion of the auction) or if the obligation to pay interest is specified in another law, the bailiff prepares a calculation of the total amount payable to the creditor.

(2) If there are several creditors and if the amount collected from the debtor is insufficient to fully satisfy all claims, the bailiff prepares a calculation for the distribution of money among the creditors and issues it to the creditors and the debtor.

(3) If the real estate auction has been declared not to have taken place and the creditor, co-owner or last overbidder has expressed a wish to keep the real estate for themselves, the bailiff prepares a calculation to determine the amount due from this person.

(4) The calculation prepared by the bailiff may be appealed to the district (city) court according to the bailiff's place of office. An appeal may be filed against the court's decision.

(With amendments made by the laws of 19.06.2003., 17.06.2004., 05.02.2009., 28.05.2015. and 11.11.2021., which enters into force 01.12.2021.)

76.nodaļa

Protection of the rights of the creditor, debtor and other persons when executing a court judgment

#### 632.pants. Appeal of bailiff's actions

(1) The bailiff's actions in the execution of a judgment or their refusal to perform such actions, except in the case specified in Article 617 of this law, may be appealed by the creditor or debtor by submitting a reasoned complaint to the district (city) court according to the bailiff's place of office within 10 days from the day of performing the appealed action or the day when the complainant, who has not been notified of the time and place of the action to be performed, became aware of it.

(2) The complaint shall be examined in a court session within 15 days. The debtor and creditor, as well as the bailiff, shall be notified of the court session. The non-appearance of these persons is not an obstacle to the examination of the matter.

(3) Upon a reasoned request of the complainant, the judge may adopt a decision in the order specified in Article 140 of this law to postpone the enforcement action, to prohibit the bailiff from transferring money or property to the creditor or debtor, or to suspend the sale of property. The decision shall be executed immediately after its adoption.

(4) An appeal may be filed against the court's decision.

(With amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002., 19.06.2003. and 05.02.2009., which enters into force 01.03.2009.)

#### 633.pants. Protection of other persons' rights when executing a decision

(1) A person who considers that they have any rights to the described movable property or real estate to which enforcement is directed, or a part thereof, shall file a claim in court according to general jurisdiction.

(2) A claim for exclusion of property from the description act, deletion of the enforcement note in the land register or another claim shall be filed against the debtor and the creditor. If property has been described based on a criminal case judgment in the part on confiscation of property, the convicted person and the financial institution shall be summoned as defendants.

(3) If the property has already been sold, the claim shall also be submitted against the persons to whom the property has been transferred. If the court satisfies the claim in respect of real estate, the entry in the land register on the transfer of ownership rights to its acquirer shall be declared invalid.

(4) Disputes between the acquirer, creditor and debtor, if the claim for the return of sold property in kind has been satisfied, shall be examined by the court in claim proceedings.

(With amendments made by the law of 31.10.2002., which enters into force 01.01.2003.)

#### 634.pants. Reversal of judgment execution

(1) If an executed judgment is revoked and after a new examination of the case a judgment is made to dismiss the claim or a decision is made to terminate the proceedings in the case or to leave the case without examination, the defendant shall return everything that was collected from them in favor of the plaintiff according to the revoked judgment (reversal of judgment execution).

(2) If it is not possible to return the property in kind, the court's judgment or decision shall provide for compensation of the value of this property.

#### 635.pants. Decision on the question of reversal of judgment execution

(1) The court to which the case has been referred for new examination shall, on its own initiative, examine the question of reversal of judgment execution and decide it in the new judgment or decision with which the proceedings in the case are concluded.

(2) If the court examining the case anew has not decided the question of reversal of execution of the overturned judgment, the defendant is entitled to submit to that court an application for reversal of judgment execution. This application shall be examined in a court session, with prior notice thereof to the participants in the case. The non-appearance of these persons shall not be an obstacle to examination of the application.

(3) The cassation instance court, if it by its judgment amends the appealed (protested) judgment, overturns it and terminates the proceedings in the case or leaves the application without examination, shall decide the question of reversal of judgment execution or refer its decision to the court whose judgment was appealed.

(4) If the court of appeal rejects the claim in a case in which the first instance court, in accordance with Article 205 of this law, permitted immediate execution of the judgment, or terminates the proceedings in such a case or leaves the claim without examination, it shall simultaneously decide the question of reversal of judgment execution.

(5) If a judgment is overturned due to newly discovered circumstances or due to review of a decision in cases provided for by European Union legal norms, the question of reversal of judgment execution shall be decided by the court that examines the case anew after the judgment is overturned.

(6) In cases concerning recovery of maintenance, recovery of wages, recovery of damages in connection with personal injuries resulting in mutilation or other health damage or death of a person, reversal of judgment execution is permissible if the overturned judgment was based on false information provided by the claimant or on forged documents submitted by him.

(7) An interlocutory appeal may be submitted against the court's decision on the question of reversal of judgment execution.

(With amendments made by the law of 08.09.2011, which enters into force on 30.09.2011. The sixth part, insofar as it relates to reversal of judgment execution in cases concerning recovery of wages, has been declared invalid from 01.11.2015 by the judgment of the Constitutional Court of 16.04.2015, which enters into force on 20.04.2015.)

Part F

International Civil Procedure

(Part in the version of the law of 07.04.2004, which enters into force on 01.05.2004.)

Fifteenth Section

International Civil Procedural Cooperation

Chapter 77

Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Court Decisions

#### 636.pants. Foreign court decision

(1) A foreign court decision within the meaning of this chapter is a judgment adopted by a foreign court by which the dispute between the parties has been decided on the merits, as well as a settlement approved by a foreign court.

(2) A foreign court decision within the meaning of this chapter is also a decision of a foreign competent authority that is enforceable in the country of its adoption if the recognition and enforcement of the decision results from directly applicable European Union legal norms or international agreements binding on the Republic of Latvia.

(In the version of the law of 07.09.2006, which enters into force on 11.10.2006.)

#### 637.pants. Recognition of foreign court decision

(1) A foreign court decision shall be recognized in accordance with the provisions of this chapter, observing the general provisions of this law.

(2) A foreign court decision shall not be recognized only if one of the following grounds for non-recognition exists:

- 1) the foreign court that adopted the decision was not competent under Latvian law to examine the respective dispute or such dispute is subject to exclusive jurisdiction of a Latvian court;
- 2) the foreign court decision has not entered into legal force;
- 3) the defendant was denied the opportunity to defend his rights, in particular, if the defendant who did not participate in the examination of the case was not notified in a timely and proper manner of the appearance in court, except if the defendant has not appealed this decision, although he had such an opportunity;
- 4) the foreign court decision is not compatible with a court decision already earlier adopted in Latvia and having entered into legal force in the same dispute between the same parties or with proceedings already earlier commenced in a Latvian court between the same parties;
- 5) the foreign court decision is not compatible with such an already earlier adopted and entered into legal force decision of another foreign court in the same dispute between the same parties, which is recognizable or has already been recognized in Latvia;
- 6) recognition of the foreign court decision is contrary to the public order of Latvia;
- 7) when adopting the foreign court decision, the law of the country that would be applicable according to the conflict of laws norms of Latvian international private law was not applied.
  - (3) A foreign court decision in cases arising from guardianship, curatorship or contact rights shall not be recognized only if at least one of the grounds for non-recognition mentioned in points 1, 2, 3, 6 and 7 of the second part of this article exists or one of the following grounds for non-recognition:
- 1) the foreign court decision is not compatible with a court decision later adopted in Latvia and having entered into legal force in the same dispute between the same parties or with proceedings later commenced in a Latvian court between the same parties;
- 2) the foreign court decision is not compatible with a later adopted and entered into legal force decision of another foreign court in the same dispute between the same parties, which is recognizable or has already been recognized in Latvia.
  - (31) A foreign court decision in cases concerning recovery of maintenance, which amends an already earlier adopted decision on recovery of maintenance, based on changed circumstances, shall not be considered an incompatible judgment within the meaning of points 4 and 5 of the second part of this article.
  - (4) When deciding the question of whether a foreign court decision is recognizable in accordance with the second part of this article, the judge or court shall be guided by the circumstances established by the foreign court decision.
  - (5) If several claims combined in one action have been satisfied by a foreign court decision and this decision is not recognizable in full, the foreign court decision may be recognized in relation to one or several satisfied claims.

(With amendments made by the laws of 07.09.2006 and 29.10.2015, which enters into force on 03.12.2015.)

#### 638.pants. Submission of Application

(1) An application for recognition or recognition and enforcement of a foreign court judgment shall be submitted for consideration to the district (city) court according to the place of enforcement of the judgment or according to the defendant's declared place of residence, but if there is none — according to the defendant's place of residence or legal address.

(2) The application shall indicate:

- 1) the name of the court to which the application has been submitted;
- 11) the applicant's name, surname, personal identification number (if there is none — other identification data) and address for communication with the court; for a legal person — its name, registration number and legal address. If the applicant consents to electronic communication with the court, also indicate the e-mail address and, if registered in the online system for communication with the court, also include an indication of registration;
- 12) the defendant's name, surname, personal identification number (if there is none, then other identification data), declared place of residence and additional address indicated in the declaration, but if there are none — place of residence; for a legal person — its name, registration number and legal address;
- 2) (deleted by the law of 29.11.2012.);
- 3) the subject matter of the application and the circumstances on which the application is based;
- 4) the applicant's request to recognize or recognize and enforce the foreign court judgment in full or in any part thereof;
- 5) the representative's e-mail address and, if registered in the online system for communication with the court, also include an indication of registration, if the application is submitted by a representative whose address for communication with the court is in Latvia and who consents to electronic communication with the court. If the applicant's representative's address is outside Latvia, additionally indicate the e-mail address or notify of the registration of their participation in the online system;
- 6) a list of attached documents;
- 7) the time of preparation of the application.
  - (21) An application in a case concerning recognition or declaration of enforceability of a foreign court judgment on maintenance recovery in cases provided for in European Union and international treaties, using the forms specified in the respective legal acts, may be submitted or forwarded through the Latvian central authorities designated to ensure cooperation.
  - (3) The following shall be attached to the application:
- 1) the foreign court judgment with confirmation that the judgment has entered into legal force;
- 2) a document issued by the foreign court confirming that the defendant who did not participate in the proceedings was duly notified in a timely manner of the time and place of the proceedings;
- 3) a document issued by the foreign court or competent institution on the enforcement of the judgment, if the foreign court judgment has already been partially enforced;
- 4) a document issued by the foreign court confirming that the foreign court judgment is enforceable in the country of its adoption, if the applicant requests recognition and enforcement of the foreign court judgment;
- 5) a translation in the state language of the application and the documents referred to in points 1, 2 and 3 of this paragraph, certified in the prescribed manner;
- 6) a document confirming payment of the state fee in the manner and amount established by law, except when the application has been submitted and payment has been made in the online system".
  - (4) The application shall be signed by the applicant or their representative. If the application has been signed by a representative, a power of attorney or other document confirming the representative's authority to submit the application to the court shall be attached to the application.
  - (5) An unsigned application shall be considered as not submitted and shall be sent back to the submitter.
  - (6) The judge shall adopt a decision to refuse to accept the application if a power of attorney or other document confirming the representative's authority to submit this application to the court is not attached thereto. The decision is not appealable.

(With amendments made by the laws of 02.09.2004., 07.09.2006., 09.06.2011., 08.09.2011., 29.11.2012., 23.04.2015., 29.10.2015., 23.11.2016., 01.06.2017. and 11.11.2021., which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

#### 639.pants. Leaving the Application Without Movement

If the application does not comply with the requirements of the second and third parts of Article 638 of this Law, or if the power of attorney or other document attached to the application does not confer authority on the representative to submit this application to the court, the judge shall leave the application without movement and the consequences provided for in Article 133 of this Law shall apply.

(In the wording of the law of 23.04.2015., which enters into force on 26.05.2015.)

#### 640.pants. Adjudication of the Application

A decision on recognition and enforcement of the foreign court judgment or a decision to dismiss the application shall be adopted by the judge individually on the basis of the submitted application and the documents attached thereto within 10 days after initiation of the case, without summoning the parties.

(With amendments made by the law of 23.04.2015., which enters into force on 26.05.2015.)

#### 641.pants. Entry into Force and Appeal of Decisions of the Court of First Instance and the Court of Appeal

(1) A separate complaint may be submitted to the regional court against a decision of the court of first instance in a case concerning recognition of a foreign court judgment, and the decision of the regional court on the separate complaint may be appealed to the Supreme Court by submitting a separate complaint.

(2) A participant in the case whose declared place of residence, but if there is none — place of residence or legal address is in Latvia, may submit the separate complaint referred to in the first paragraph of this Article within 30 days from the date of issue of the decision, but a participant in the case whose declared place of residence, but if there is none — place of residence or legal address is not in Latvia — within 60 days from the date of issue of the decision.

(21) In cases provided for in Council Regulation No 4/2009, a participant in the case whose declared place of residence, but if there is none — place of residence or legal address is not in Latvia, may submit the separate complaint referred to in the first paragraph of this Article within 45 days from the date of issue of the decision.

(3) The decision of the court of first instance and the decision of the court of appeal shall enter into legal force after the time limit for appeal thereof has expired, calculated from the date of issue of the later decision, and no separate complaint has been submitted.

(4) If in the case referred to in the third paragraph of this Article no relevant confirmation of the issue of the decision has been received, the decision shall enter into legal force six months after its pronouncement.

(With amendments made by the laws of 05.02.2009., 09.06.2011., 29.11.2012., 30.10.2014. and 11.11.2021., which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

#### 642.pants. Competence of the Regional Court

(1) The regional court, when considering a separate complaint, has the right to:

- 1) leave the decision unchanged and dismiss the complaint;
- 2) revoke the decision in full or in any part thereof and decide the question of recognition of the foreign court judgment;
- 3) amend the decision.
  - (2) The court may request explanations from the parties or additional information from the foreign court that adopted the judgment.
  - (21) When applying Council Regulation No 4/2009, the separate complaint shall be examined within the time limits established in Article 34 of Council Regulation No 4/2009.
  - (3) The court may, at the request of the defendant, stay the proceedings if the foreign court judgment has been appealed in the respective foreign country in the general procedure or the time limit for such appeal has not expired. In the second case, the court may set a time limit within which a complaint must be submitted for appealing the foreign court judgment in the respective foreign country.

(With amendments made by the laws of 09.06.2011., 30.10.2014. and 23.04.2015., which enters into force on 26.05.2015.)

#### 643.pants. Securing the Enforcement of a Foreign Court Judgment

(1) Upon the applicant's application, the judge or court in the decision by which the foreign court judgment is recognized may establish the measures provided for in Article 138 or Chapter 77.3 of this Law for securing the enforcement of the foreign court judgment.

(2) Submission of the separate complaint referred to in the first paragraph of Article 641 of this Law shall not stay the execution of the judge's or court's decision in the part concerning securing the enforcement of the foreign court judgment. Submission of a separate complaint against such a decision in a case concerning recognition of a foreign court judgment, by which the securing of enforcement of the foreign court judgment has been revoked or the means of securing has been changed, shall stay the execution of the decision in this part.

(With amendments made by the laws of 07.09.2006. and 08.12.2016., which enters into force on 04.01.2017. The amendments to the Article in connection with the European Account Preservation Order enter into force on 18.01.2017. See point 121 of the transitional provisions)

#### 644.pants. Enforcement of Foreign Court Decisions

(1) A foreign court decision that is enforceable in the country of its adoption shall, following its recognition, be enforced in the procedure established by this Law.

(2) With respect to the procedure for declaring enforcement of a judgment provided for in the Lugano Convention of 30 October 2007 on jurisdiction and the recognition and enforcement of judgments in civil and commercial matters, Council Regulation No. 2201/2003, Council Regulation No. 4/2009 and Regulation (EU) No. 650/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 4 July 2012 on jurisdiction, applicable law, recognition and enforcement of decisions and acceptance and enforcement of authentic instruments in matters of succession and on the creation of a European Certificate of Succession (hereinafter – Regulation No. 650/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council), the provisions of Chapter 77 of this Law on recognition of foreign court decisions shall apply insofar as the provisions of the relevant convention and regulations permit.

(3) In cases provided for in Council Regulation No. 2201/2003, Regulation (EC) No. 805/2004 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Regulation (EC) No. 861/2007 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Regulation (EC) No. 1896/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Council Regulation No. 4/2009, Regulation (EU) No. 1215/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Regulation (EU) No. 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council and Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111, foreign court decisions shall be enforceable in the procedure established by this Law without requiring recognition of the foreign court decision or declaration of enforcement of the foreign court decision.

(4) Costs related to the enforcement of a foreign court decision shall be covered in the general procedure.

(07.09.2006. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 05.02.2009., 09.06.2011., 29.11.2012., 30.10.2014., 28.05.2015., 08.12.2016. un 16.06.2022. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 07.07.2022. Grozījums trešajā daļā stājas spēkā 01.08.2022. Sk. pārejas noteikumu 177. punktu)

644.1 pants. Postponement of Enforcement of Foreign Court Decision, Division into Instalments, Amendment of Type or Procedure of Enforcement

(1) The court that has adopted a decision on the recognition and enforcement of a foreign court decision may, upon application by a party, postpone enforcement of the foreign court decision, divide enforcement into instalments, or amend the type or procedure of enforcement.

(11) The district (city) court in whose territory a foreign court decision is to be enforced, in respect of which a certificate referred to in point (b) or (c) of paragraph 1 of Article 36 or point (a) or (b) of paragraph 1 of Article 47 of Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111 has been issued, may, upon receipt of the debtor's application, on the basis of paragraph 4 of Article 56 of the said Regulation, postpone enforcement of the foreign court decision.

(2) The application shall be examined in written proceedings, after prior notice to the parties. Simultaneously with the notice, the court shall send to the parties the application for postponement of enforcement of the judgment, division into instalments, or amendment of its type or procedure of enforcement, setting a time limit for submission of explanations.

(21) An application in a case concerning a child shall be examined in a court hearing, after prior notice to the parties and the orphan's court. Failure of the parties to appear shall not be an obstacle to examination of the application.

(22) In a decision on postponement of enforcement of a foreign decision in a case concerning a child, the court shall specify the obligations of the debtor and creditor during the period when enforcement of the decision is postponed and, if necessary, also the procedure by which contact between the child and the creditor is to be restored.

(3) A decision on postponement of enforcement of a foreign court decision, division into instalments or amendment of the type and procedure of enforcement shall be enforceable immediately. An appeal on points of law may be filed against the court decision. Filing of an appeal on points of law shall not suspend enforcement of the decision.

(07.09.2006. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 08.09.2011., 29.10.2015. un 16.06.2022. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 07.07.2022. 1.1, 2.1 un 2.2 daļa; grozījums pirmajā daļā un trešās daļas jaunā redakcija stājas spēkā 01.08.2022. Sk. pārejas noteikumu 177. punktu)

644.2 pants. Enforcement Issues Related to European Union Enforcement Documents

(1) The district (city) court in whose territory the relevant foreign court decision is to be enforced, upon application by the debtor, on the basis of Article 23 of Regulation (EC) No. 805/2004 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Article 23 of Regulation (EC) No. 861/2007 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Article 23 of Regulation (EC) No. 1896/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council, paragraph 3 of Article 21 of Council Regulation No. 4/2009, Article 44 of Regulation (EU) No. 1215/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council or paragraphs 1 and 2 of Article 56 of Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111, shall be entitled to:

- 1) replace enforcement of the decision with measures provided for in Article 138 of this Law to ensure enforcement of the decision;
- 2) amend the type or procedure of enforcement of the decision;
- 3) suspend enforcement of the decision.
  - (2) (Deleted by the Law of 23.04.2015.)
  - (3) The application referred to in paragraph one of this Article shall be examined in a court hearing, after prior notice to the parties. Failure of these persons to appear shall not be an obstacle to examination of the application.
  - (4) An appeal on points of law may be filed against the court decision.

(07.09.2006. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 05.02.2009., 09.06.2011., 30.10.2014., 23.04.2015. un 16.06.2022. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 07.07.2022. Grozījums pirmajā daļā stājas spēkā 01.08.2022. Sk. pārejas noteikumu 177 punktu)

644.3 pants. Refusal of Enforcement of Foreign Court Decision

(1) The district (city) court in whose territory a foreign court decision that has been certified as a European Enforcement Order is to be enforced may, upon receipt of the debtor's application, on the basis of Article 21 of Regulation (EC) No. 805/2004 of the European Parliament and of the Council, refuse enforcement of the decision.

(2) The district (city) court in whose territory a foreign court decision is to be enforced, in respect of which a certificate referred to in paragraph 1 of Article 41 or paragraph 1 of Article 42 of Council Regulation No. 2201/2003 has been issued, may, upon receipt of a party's application, on the basis of Article 47 of the said Regulation, refuse enforcement of the decision.

(3) The district (city) court in whose territory a foreign court decision is to be enforced, in respect of which a certificate referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 20 of Regulation (EC) No. 861/2007 of the European Parliament and of the Council has been issued, may, upon receipt of a party's application, on the basis of Article 22 of the said Regulation, refuse enforcement of the decision.

(4) The district (city) court in whose territory a European payment order is to be enforced may, upon receipt of the debtor's application, on the basis of Article 22 of Regulation (EC) No. 1896/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council, refuse enforcement of the decision.

(41) The district (city) court in whose territory a foreign court decision is to be enforced, in respect of which an extract referred to in point (b) of paragraph 1 of Article 20 of Council Regulation No. 4/2009 has been issued, may, upon receipt of the debtor's application, on the basis of paragraph 2 of Article 21 of the said Regulation, refuse enforcement of the decision.

(42) The district (city) court in whose territory a foreign court decision is to be enforced, in respect of which a certificate referred to in Article 53 or 60 of Regulation (EU) No. 1215/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council has been issued, may, upon receipt of the debtor's application, on the basis of Article 46 of the said Regulation, refuse enforcement of the decision.

(43) The district (city) court in whose territory control of enforcement of a protective measure established by a foreign court decision is to be carried out may, upon receipt of a person's application, on the basis of Article 13 of Council Regulation No. 606/2013, refuse enforcement of the decision.

(44) The district (city) court in whose territory a foreign court decision is to be enforced, in respect of which a certificate referred to in point (b) or (c) of paragraph 1 of Article 36 or point (a) or (b) of paragraph 1 of Article 47 of Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111 has been issued, or an authentic instrument issued or agreement approved by a foreign authority, in respect of which a certificate referred to in point (b) of paragraph 1 of Article 66 of Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111 has been issued, may, upon receipt of the debtor's application, on the basis of Articles 41, 50, paragraph 6 of Article 56 or paragraph 3 of Article 68 of the said Regulation, refuse enforcement of the decision, authentic instrument or agreement, respectively.

(5) The application shall be examined in a court hearing, after prior notice to the parties. Failure of these persons to appear shall not be an obstacle to examination of the application.

(6) An appeal on points of law may be filed against the court decision.

(05.02.2009. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 09.06.2011., 30.10.2014. un 16.06.2022. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 07.07.2022. 4.4 daļa un grozījums piektajā daļā stājas spēkā 01.08.2022. Sk. pārejas noteikumu 177. punktu)

644.4 pants. Filing of Application for Postponement of Enforcement of Foreign Court Decision, European Union Enforcement Document, Division into Instalments, Amendment of Type or Procedure of Enforcement, Suspension or Refusal of Enforcement

(1) The application referred to in Articles 644.1, 644.2 and 644.3 of this Law shall specify:

- 1) the name of the court to which the application is submitted;
- 11) the applicant's given name, surname, personal identity number (if there is none – other identification data) and address for communication with the court; for a legal person – its name, registration number and legal address. If the applicant consents to electronic communication with the court, also the electronic mail address and, if registered in the online system for communication with the court, also an indication of registration;
- 12) the respondent's (creditor's) given name, surname, personal identity number (if there is none, then other identification data), declared place of residence and additional address indicated in the declaration, but if there are none – the place of residence; for a legal person – its name, registration number and legal address;
- 2) (deleted by the Law of 29.11.2012);
- 3) the subject of the application and the circumstances on which the application is based;
- 4) the applicant's request;
- 5) the representative's electronic mail address and, if registered in the online system for communication with the court, also an indication of registration, if the application is submitted by a representative whose address for communication with the court is in Latvia and who consents to electronic communication with the court. If the applicant's representative's address is outside Latvia, additionally the electronic mail address shall be indicated or notification of registration of their participation in the online system shall be given;
- 6) a list of attached documents;
- 7) the time of drafting of the application.
  - (2) The following shall be attached to the application:
- 1) a duly certified foreign court decision;
- 2) in relevant cases – a European Union enforcement document issued by a foreign court or competent authority;
- 3) other documents on which the applicant's application is based;
- 4) a translation of the application and of the documents referred to in points 1, 2 and 3 of this paragraph, certified in the established procedure, into the official language.
  - (3) The application shall be signed by the applicant or their representative. If the application has been signed by the applicant's representative, a power of attorney or other document certifying the authorisation to submit this application to the court shall be attached to the application.
  - (4) An unsigned application shall be considered not submitted and shall be sent back to the submitter.
  - (5) The judge shall adopt a decision to refuse to accept the application if a power of attorney or other document certifying the representative's authorisation to submit this application to the court is not attached. The decision shall not be appealable.

644.5 pants. Leaving Without Progress a Submitted Application for Postponement of Enforcement of Foreign Court Decision – European Union Enforcement Document, Division into Instalments, Amendment of Type or Procedure of Enforcement, Suspension or Refusal of Enforcement

If an application submitted in accordance with Articles 644.1, 644.2 or 644.3 of this Law does not comply with the requirements of paragraphs one and two of Article 644.4 of this Law or if the power of attorney or other document attached to the application does not contain authorisation for the representative to submit this application to the court, the judge shall leave the application without progress and the consequences provided for in Article 133 of this Law shall apply.

### 77. Chapter

Cases concerning provision of an opinion to a foreign court on the lawfulness of a child's removal across the border to a foreign country or retention in a foreign country

### (Chapter in the version of the Law of 07.09.2006, which entered into force on 11.10.2006. Title of the Chapter in the version of the Law of 14.12.2017, which entered into force on 15.01.2018. See Point 135 of the transitional provisions)

Article 644.6. Procedure for Examination of Cases

Cases concerning provision of an opinion to a foreign court on the lawfulness of removal across the border to a foreign country or retention in a foreign country of a child whose place of residence is in Latvia shall be examined in accordance with the provisions of this chapter, observing the general provisions of this law.

(In the version of the Law of 14.12.2017, which entered into force on 15.01.2018.)

Article 644.7. Application for provision of an opinion to a foreign court in a case concerning the lawfulness of a child's removal across the border to a foreign country or retention in a foreign country

(1) If a foreign court is examining a case concerning the return to Latvia of a child unlawfully removed to or retained in that foreign country, at the request of that court, a person whose rights to exercise custody or guardianship have been violated, as well as an orphan's court or a prosecutor, may submit an application to a court for provision of an opinion to the foreign court on the lawfulness of the child's removal from Latvia across the border to a foreign country or retention in a foreign country. The application referred to in this paragraph may be submitted if the relevant foreign country whose court is examining the case concerning the return to Latvia of a child unlawfully removed to or retained in that foreign country is a contracting state to the Hague Convention of 25 October 1980 on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction or the Hague Convention of 19 October 1996 on Jurisdiction, Applicable Law, Recognition, Enforcement and Cooperation in Respect of Parental Responsibility and Measures for the Protection of Children.

(11) The application referred to in paragraph one of this Article may also be submitted to a court by a person whose rights to exercise custody or guardianship have been violated, as well as by an orphan's court or a prosecutor, even if a request from a foreign court has not been received, but the said person, orphan's court or prosecutor considers that provision of such an opinion to a foreign court is expedient.

(2) Cases concerning provision of an opinion to a foreign court in a case concerning the unlawful removal of a child across the border to a foreign country or retention in a foreign country, if the child's place of residence is in Latvia, shall be examined by Riga City Court.

(21) (Deleted by the Law of 30.10.2014)

(3) The application shall indicate:

- 1) the name of the court to which the application is submitted;
- 2) the applicant's given name, surname, personal identity number (if there is none — other identification data), declared place of residence and additional address indicated in the declaration, or, if there are none — the place of residence, as well as an address in Latvia for communication with the court in order to receive court documents. If the applicant agrees to electronic communication with the court, the e-mail address shall also be indicated and, if the applicant has registered in the online system for communication with the court, a reference to the registration shall also be included;
- 3) the given name, surname, personal identity number (if there is none, date of birth) of the unlawfully removed or retained child and other information about the child, as well as information about the child's possible location and the identity of the person with whom the child may be located;
- 4) the respondent's given name, surname, personal identity number (if there is none, other identification data), declared place of residence and additional address indicated in the declaration, as well as the place of residence if it differs from the declared place of residence and the additional address indicated in the declaration, or information about their location;
- 5) circumstances confirming the applicant's custody or guardianship rights;
- 6) circumstances confirming the fact of unlawful removal or retention of the child and the civil aspects;
- 7) the applicant's request;
- 8) a list of attached documents;
- 9) the time of preparation of the application.
  - (4) The application shall be accompanied by documents on which it is based and the request of the foreign court, if there is one.
  - (5) The application shall be signed by the applicant or their representative. If the application is submitted by the applicant's representative, a power of attorney or other document certifying the authorisation to apply to the court with this application shall be attached to the application. If the address of the applicant's representative is outside Latvia, an e-mail address shall additionally be indicated or notification of registration of their participation in the online system shall be provided.
  - (6) An unsigned application shall be considered as not submitted and shall be sent back to the submitter.
  - (7) A judge shall adopt a decision to refuse to accept the application if it is not accompanied by a power of attorney or other document certifying the representative's authorisation to apply to the court with this application. The decision is not subject to appeal.

(With amendments made by the Laws of 04.08.2011, 29.11.2012, 30.10.2014, 23.04.2015, 23.11.2016, 01.06.2017, 14.12.2017, 11.11.2021 and 16.06.2022, which entered into force on 01.08.2022.)

Article 644.8. Leaving the application without progress

If the application does not comply with the requirements of paragraphs three and four of Article 644.7 of this law or if the authorisation of the representative to apply to the court with this application does not follow from the power of attorney or other document attached to the application, the court shall leave the application without progress and the consequences provided for in Article 133 of this law shall occur.

(In the version of the Law of 23.04.2015, which entered into force on 26.05.2015.)

Article 644.9. Examination of the application

(1) The application shall be examined in a court session within 15 days after initiation of the case, with the participation of the submitter of the application and a representative of the relevant orphan's court. The orphan's court shall have the rights of a participant in the case as provided for in paragraph two of Article 88 of this law.

(2) The respondent shall be notified of the court session. The failure of this person to appear shall not be an obstacle to examination of the application.

(3) The court shall adopt a decision by which it provides an opinion to the foreign court on the lawfulness of the child's removal from Latvia across the border to a foreign country or retention in a foreign country.

(4) If the court establishes that the child is located in Latvia, it shall adopt a decision to leave the application without examination.

(5) When examining the application, the court shall request evidence on its own initiative.

(6) (Deleted by the Law of 14.12.2017)

(7) The court decision shall enter into force immediately and is not subject to appeal.

(In the version of the Law of 04.08.2011 with amendments made by the Laws of 29.11.2012, 14.12.2017 and 11.11.2021, which entered into force on 01.12.2021.)

Article 644.10. Competence of the regional court

(Deleted by the Law of 14.12.2017, which entered into force on 15.01.2018.)

Article 644.11. Actions after adoption of the decision

(1) The court shall submit the adopted decision by which an opinion has been provided to the foreign court on the lawfulness of the child's removal from Latvia across the border to a foreign country or retention in a foreign country to the Ministry of Justice if the request for the child's return to Latvia has been submitted to the foreign country through the intermediation of the Ministry of Justice.

(2) (Deleted by the Law of 12.06.2009)

(3) The court on its own initiative or the Ministry of Justice shall append to the court documents information on the provisions of Latvian legal acts.

(With amendments made by the Laws of 12.06.2009, 14.12.2017 and 11.11.2021, which entered into force on 01.12.2021.)

Article 644.12. Consequences of a decision adopted by a foreign court or competent authority on non-return of a child

(1) A decision of a foreign court or competent authority and other documents concerning non-return of a child to Latvia, adopted on the basis of Article 13 of the Hague Convention of 25 October 1980 on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction, may be submitted to a court in Latvia in accordance with paragraph 3 of Article 29 of Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111 through the intermediation of the Ministry of Justice.

(2) The Ministry of Justice, having received the documents referred to in paragraph one of this Article, shall send them to the court in whose records the case for examination on the merits is located, informing the relevant orphan's court of the decision of the foreign court or competent authority.

(3) (Deleted as of 01.08.2022 by the Law of 16.06.2022. See Point 177 of the transitional provisions)

(In the version of the Law of 04.08.2011 with amendments made by the Laws of 29.11.2012, 30.10.2014, 14.12.2017 and 16.06.2022, which entered into force on 07.07.2022. The amendment in paragraphs one and two entered into force on 01.08.2022. See Point 177 of the transitional provisions)
